Acrid Earth.name: Acrid Earth
Acrid Earth.description: You wield earth as a chemist wields reagents, its caustic bite answering a sharp and incisive mind. Your usage of the Rune of Earth scales with @Rule[ability.intellect] instead of @Rule[ability.wisdom].

Acrobat.name: Acrobat
Acrobat.description: You fight with the fluid grace of an acrobat, treating your weapon as a vaulting pole as readily as an armament. While wielding a Balanced 2H weapon, your movement does not provoke a @Action[default reactiveStrike], and jumping costs you no more movement than walking. Your whirling weapon also bats aside incoming missiles, imposing @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes} on ranged weapon attacks made against you.

Vaulting Sweep.name: Vaulting Sweep
Vaulting Sweep.description: You vault into the air and crash down amid your foes, your weapon whirling in a dazzling arc. Choose a point at least half your @Rule[movement.stride] away but no farther than your full @Rule[movement.stride] and leap to it, then make a @Action[default strike] against every creature within your weapon's reach of where you land, friend or foe.

Adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
Adrenaline.description: Pain sharpens your concentration. Once per round, when you sustain @Rule[resource.health] damage from an attack, you gain @Rule[resource.focus]{+1 Focus}.

Adrenaline Surge.name: Adrenaline Surge
Adrenaline Surge.description: You can draw upon exceptional reserves of physical strength to meet challenges imposed on your body.

Adrenaline Surge.name: Adrenaline Surge
Adrenaline Surge.description: You expend @Rule[resource.heroism] and benefit from @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to any action which scales using @Rule[ability.strength] for 3 Rounds. You may perform this action outside of your turn in Combat before making a @Rule[action.reaction].

Adroit Kinesis.name: Adroit Kinesis
Adroit Kinesis.description: You wield kinetic power with unbridled speed, hurling myriad projectiles with nimble finger-work. Your use of the Rune of Kinesis scales with @Rule[ability.dexterity] instead of @Rule[ability.presence].

Alchemical Resolve.name: Alchemical Resolve
Alchemical Resolve.description: You rapidly apply alchemical vapours which instill your ally with supplemental bravery in the face of horror.

Alchemical Resolve.name: Alchemical Resolve
Alchemical Resolve.description: You rapidly bolster the @Rule[resource.morale] of an ally within 4 feet by applying vapours. Perform a @Rule[skill.medicine] check against the target's @Rule[defense.madness]. Successful checks restore @Rule[resource.morale].

Anticipate Harm.name: Anticipate Harm
Anticipate Harm.description: Your keen reflexes and acuity allow you to anticipate imminent danger and react to avoid it.

Anticipate Harm.name: Anticipate Harm
Anticipate Harm.condition: You are targeted by an area-of-effect attack, the source of which you can see.
Anticipate Harm.description:
You may immediately move up to 4 feet after the area-of-effect of the attack is declared. If this movement escapes the area of the attack, you are unaffected.

Playtest Notes

The avoidance of being targeted is not currently automated.

Arcane Archer.name: Arcane Archer
Arcane Archer.description:
Your skill with archery can shape your spellcraft, partially substituting for the somatic gestures of traditional spellcasting.

While using a Projectile weapon as your mainhand weapon, your @Rule[action.strike]{Strikes} scale using @Rule[ability.wisdom] instead of @Rule[ability.strength] in addition to @Rule[ability.dexterity].

Spells you cast using @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.gesturearrow0000]{Gesture: Arrow} ignore the free-hand requirement, use your weapon range, and the gesture scales using @Rule[ability.wisdom] instead of @Rule[ability.intellect].

Immediately after performing a Strike with a projectile weapon, you may cast a spell with its @Rule[resource.action] cost reduced by 1.

Arcing Bolt.name: Arcing Bolt
Arcing Bolt.description: Your bolt does not stop where it lands. Loosed with a practiced flick, it springs onward to a second foe standing close by.

Arcing Bolt.name: Arcing Bolt
Arcing Bolt.description: You perform a Talisman attack against a single target. The bolt then arcs to the nearest other enemy within 10 feet of your target which has line of sight to it, striking that foe for reduced damage. The second target is chosen automatically.

Armor Crusher.name: Armor Crusher
Armor Crusher.description: You have mastered the art of striking armored opponents with such force that the armor itself becomes a weapon against them.

Armor Crusher.name: Armor Crusher
Armor Crusher.description: You make an unarmed Strike against a nearby enemy. If the attack results in a Glancing Blow, you spend @Rule[resource.focus]{1 Focus} if possible to deal bonus damage equal to your @Rule[ability.toughness] score.

Armored Efficiency.name: Armored Efficiency
Armored Efficiency.description: You are trained in wearing the heaviest types of armor while still retaining mobility. You are able to use a @Rule[movement.freeMovement]{Free Move} once per turn while wearing Heavy armor.

Armored Instinct.name: Armored Instinct
Armored Instinct.description: You instinctively angle your body to absorb the brunt of deflected blows. When an attack against you results in a Glancing Blow, you gain +1 Resistance against the damage dealt.

Armored Shell.name: Armored Shell
Armored Shell.description:
You are expert in using your armor in combination with your shield to create a defensive shell.

When you have the @Condition[guarded] condition and have a Heavy Shield equipped, your base @Rule[defense.armor] defense is reduced by half but your @Rule[defense.block] defense increases by a corresponding amount.

Artful Parry.name: Artful Parry
Artful Parry.description: You anticipate dodging an attack, intercepting it to intentionally Parry the strike.

Artful Parry.name: Artful Parry
Artful Parry.condition: You Dodge an incoming melee Strike.
Artful Parry.description: When you defend against a melee attack using the @Rule[defense.dodge] defense, you can react and expend @Rule[resource.focus] to instead @Rule[defense.parry] the attack.

Artificer.name: Artificer
Artificer.description: You excel in applying the skills of @Rule[skill.arcana], @Rule[skill.glyphweaving], and @Rule[skill.enchanting] to create innovative and practical equipment. You can perform temporary modification of equipment to apply affix enchantments or to deepen the strength of a particular enchantment.

Imbue Affix.name: Imbue Affix
Imbue Affix.description:
Over the course of a @Action[default rest], you channel arcane energy into your equipment, inscribing an Affix as a temporary enchantment. Choose one physical item that has capacity for enchantment and temporarily imbue it with a Tier 1 Affix of your choice. The imbued affix persists until you use Imbue Affix again.

Playtest Notes

You may currently imbue any affix that the chosen item can bear. In a future update this will be limited to affixes which you are able to Enchant.

Amplify Affix.name: Amplify Affix
Amplify Affix.description: Over the course of a @Action[default rest], you deepen the potency of an Affix enchantment on one of your items. Choose one Affix on a physical item you have equipped and increase the Tier of that affix by one, up to its maximum. This amplification persists until you use Amplify Affix again.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.description:
You specialize in bringing death the the unwary. Any Strike or Spell attack against an @Condition[unaware] target becomes @Rule[action.deadly].

An @Condition[unaware] creature hit by your attack may not alert its allies until its own turn in Combat.

Mark For Death.name: Mark For Death
Mark For Death.description:
You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a Knowledge Test about your target. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the target is Vulnerable. Your minimum Initiative during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the Initiative of your marked target.

Playtest Notes

This action is not yet automated.

Assess Resolve.name: Assess Resolve
Assess Resolve.description:
You take a moment to observe a creature which you can see and develop intuition about whether its body or its spirit is the more resilient.

Perform a Knowledge Test using the appropriate Skill for the creature. On a success, you learn whether the creature has greater maximum @Rule[resource.health] or greater maximum @Rule[resource.morale]. On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] the Gamemaster additionally describes how the creature is likely to behave should it become @Condition[broken].

Assess Resolve.name: Assess Resolve
Assess Resolve.description: You observe a creature you can see to judge whether its body or its spirit is the more resilient.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.description: You focus your cunning instincts on exploiting the weak points of a @Condition[flanked] target. You identify an opportunity and strike with deadly efficiency.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.condition: You are attacking a target with the Flanked condition.
Backstab.description: You Strike with your weapon against a @Condition[flanked] target, dealing @Rule[action.deadly] damage.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.description:
You practice the oral and musical traditions of heroic storytelling to inspire courage in your allies, demoralize your foes, and be quick with unconventional solutions to problems.

You learn Rune: Soul if you do not already know it. When restoring the @Rule[resource.morale] of allies using the Rune of Soul you gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to your roll.

Laughing Matter.name: Laughing Matter
Laughing Matter.condition: An enemy's attack fails to deal any damage or cause any effect to you or any ally.
Laughing Matter.description:
When an enemy's attack fails to deal any damage or cause any effect to you or any ally, you construct a cutting jest or pantomime which makes a fool of their feeble effort.

You make an @Rule[skill.performance] skill attack against the target's @Rule[defense.fortitude], dealing Psychic damage to @Rule[resource.morale] upon a success. Furthermore, upon a success, the target suffers @Rule[dice.bane]{+1 Bane} to all rolls until the start of their next turn.

The target must be able to see and understand you to be affected by this ability.

Bastion.name: Bastion
Bastion.description:
You have mastered the art of the defensive stand, becoming an unbreakable wall. While you have the @Condition[guarded] condition, you have the following benefits:

  • You cannot be moved against your will or knocked @Condition[prone].

  • Your space cannot be crossed by enemies, even when using abilities that would normally move through a creature.

  • Your @Rule[movement.engagement] increases by +1, holding more foes at bay.

  • Your @Rule[defense.reflex] defense is treated as the sum of your @Rule[defense.armor] and @Rule[defense.block] defenses, if greater, as you endure attacks rather than avoiding them. An attack against your @Rule[defense.reflex] which you resist is treated as having been defended by @Rule[defense.block].

Get Behind Me.name: Get Behind Me
Get Behind Me.description:
Choose an ally adjacent to you and reposition them to be directly behind you, based on your direction of facing at the time this action is used, interposing yourself between that ally and their attackers.

This movement does not provoke a @Action[default reactiveStrike] and the protected ally gains the @Condition[guarded] condition until the start of their next turn.

Battle Focus.name: Battle Focus
Battle Focus.description: You find focus and calm within the thrill of battle. When you achieve a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} that deals damage to @Rule[resource.health] or @Rule[resource.morale] you gain @Rule[resource.focus]{+1 Focus}. This benefit may occur at most once per Round.

Battle-Worn.name: Battle-Worn
Battle-Worn.description: Your body has endured so many injuries that it has learned how to mend itself with remarkable efficiency. When you perform the @Action[default rest] action, you recover additional @Rule[resource.wounds] equal to half your @Rule[ability.toughness] score (rounded down).

Beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
Beastmaster.description:
You have trained your animal companion to aid you in combat. Your companion may participate in encounters as an allied combatant, and you have developed techniques for teaming up on enemies.

Your companion is a Minion-threat Adversary, its level equal to half of yours, rounding up. Your companion is marked Important, meaning that they use the reserve resources of @Rule[resource.wounds] and @Rule[resource.madness].

Bond Companion.name: Bond Companion
Bond Companion.description: You form a bond with a beast, and it becomes your loyal companion.

Release Companion.name: Release Companion
Release Companion.description: It is time for you and your companion to part ways. You release it back to the wilds.

Exploit Opening.name: Exploit Opening
Exploit Opening.description: You focus and make an @Rule[action.accurate] Strike with your weapon against a target that is @Condition[flanked] and engaged by your Companion.

Berserk Strike.name: Berserk Strike
Berserk Strike.description: You channel your lust for combat into an adrenaline-fueled strike which increases in power as you become more wounded.

Berserk Strike.name: Berserk Strike
Berserk Strike.description:
You imbue your strike with momentum and intensity, increasing the Damage Bonus of your strike according to your missing @Rule[resource.health].

  • If your Health is below 75%, your Strike deals +1 Damage

  • If your Health is below 50%, your Strike deals +2 Damage

  • If your Health is below 25%, your Strike deals +3 Damage

This damage bonus is doubled if you are using a Two-Handed weapon.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description:
You revel in the thrill of combat, hurling yourself into the fray with reckless abandon.

While @Condition[enraged] you may still spend @Rule[resource.focus] on any action which is not a spell.

Berserker Rage.name: Berserker Rage
Berserker Rage.condition: You have suffered damage to your Health pool since your last turn in Combat.
Berserker Rage.description:
You become @Condition[enraged]. While Enraged you deal 4 additional damage on all melee attacks. You may attempt to end the effect on your own turn by succeeding on a @Rule[defense.willpower] test against a DC of 20. The effect ends automatically when Combat is concluded.

Playtest Notes

The aforementioned "Willpower test" is legacy terminology. The mechanism for ending Berserker Rage on yourself is not currently determined or automated.

Blightcaller.name: Blightcaller
Blightcaller.description: Life is growth without restraint, and growth unchecked festers. Spells you compose with the Rune of Life become spells of blight. They deal @Rule[damageType.poison] damage to @Rule[resource.health] instead of restoring it, and are resisted by @Rule[defense.fortitude].

Blood Frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
Blood Frenzy.description: Your battle lust spurs you to feats of heightened action. When you achieve a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} that deals damage to @Rule[resource.health] you immediately gain @Rule[resource.action]{+1 Action}. This benefit may only happen once per Round.

Blood Magic.name: Blood Magic
Blood Magic.description:
You rely upon occult techniques to transform physical pain into arcane potential.

You cast spells by spending @Rule[resource.health] instead of @Rule[resource.focus]. When casting a spell each point of @Rule[resource.focus] costs 10 points of @Rule[resource.health] instead. Spells you cast cannot restore your own @Rule[resource.health].

Bloodletter.name: Bloodletter
Bloodletter.description:
Your precision with weapons which deal Slashing or Piercing damage can cause the @Condition[bleeding] condition on @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage to @Rule[resource.health].

The @Condition[bleeding] effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals your @Rule[ability.dexterity] score as additional damage to @Rule[resource.health].

Body Block.name: Body Block
Body Block.description: You lean into an attack which was otherwise defended with your @Rule[defense.armor], converting its result into a @Rule[defense.block] instead.

Body Block.name: Body Block
Body Block.condition: You defend against a melee attack with your Armor or as a Glance.
Body Block.description:
An attack which otherwise is defended by your @Rule[defense.armor] or produced a Glancing Blow is converted to a @Rule[defense.block] and deals no damage.

Playtest Notes

The conversion to a @Rule[defense.block] is not currently implemented, only the restriction of when this talent's action can be used.

Breakfall.name: Breakfall
Breakfall.description:
You've fallen from heights enough times to stop treating it like an emergency. You tuck your chin and spread the impact along your limbs to meet the ground with familiar grace.

You gain @Rule[defense.reflex]{+4 Reflex} defense when defending against damage from a fall of 30 feet or less.

Brutal Display.name: Brutal Display
Brutal Display.description: You go beyond simply defeating your enemies, you make an example of them. When you slay a foe, every enemy within 20 feet who can see their @Condition[dead] ally suffers damage to their @Rule[resource.morale] equal to your @Rule[ability.strength] score.

Bull Rush.name: Bull Rush
Bull Rush.description: You can use your physical prowess to push past opponents who block your path.

Bull Rush.name: Bull Rush
Bull Rush.description:
You move up to your @Rule[movement.stride] with forceful momentum, passing through the space of one other creature along your path. An ally lets you pass freely.

An enemy contests your passage: make an @Rule[skill.athletics] @Rule[action.skill] attack against its @Rule[defense.fortitude] defense. On a @Rule[dice.success] you drive through its space, knocking it @Condition[prone], and it may not make any @Action[default reactiveStrike] against you. On a @Rule[dice.failure] your movement is blocked and you remain in your current position.

Bulwark.name: Bulwark
Bulwark.description:
You have expertise in using a Shield to defend yourself and others.

While you have a Shield equipped, you may sacrifice your @Rule[movement.freeMovement] for the Round to reduce the @Rule[resource.action] cost of the @Action[default defend] action by 1.

Cadence.name: Cadence
Cadence.description: You are drilled in performing sequences of melee attacks with rhythmic precision. When you Strike multiple times in sequence using a one-handed melee weapon you gain a stacking @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} for each successive attack.

Camaraderie.name: Camaraderie
Camaraderie.description: You know how soldiers and travellers of a dozen peoples take their ease: which stories are told, which songs are sung, which silences are kept. Time spent in your company settles the mind.

Camaraderie.name: Camaraderie
Camaraderie.description: Following a @Action[default rest], you find the common ground you share with each of your companions. You make a @Rule[skill.society] check against the @Rule[defense.madness] of each of them. Upon a success they shed Madness equal to half your @Rule[ability.wisdom], or your full @Rule[ability.wisdom] upon a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess].

Carefree.name: Carefree
Carefree.description:
You are able to compartmentalize and brush off setbacks, providing a remarkable ability to recover from damage to your @Rule[resource.morale].

Your @Rule[defense.madness] is reduced by 1, making you easier to heal.

Chameleon.name: Chameleon
Chameleon.description:
You blend into your surroundings so completely that motion no longer betrays you. While you are concealed by @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.hide000000000000 hide] your @Action[default move] action is @Rule[action.subtle], allowing you to reposition without revealing yourself.

Playtest Notes

The Move action gains the tag automatically while you are concealed, so repositioning no longer ends your concealment. Crucible does not yet record which creatures have lost track of you, so whether moving into the open reveals you remains the Gamemaster's call. A forthcoming stealth effect will record detection for each creature individually.

Champion.name: Champion
Champion.description:
You relish the thrill of single combat, aspiring to become a peerless challenger who dominates rivals through overwhelming might and unyielding force of will. You can issue a Challenge, marking a rival creature as your Challenged target, and gaining bonus damage to attacks against it.

So intense is your focus that no rival may flee your grasp. You may make a @Action[default reactiveStrike] against your Challenged rival even while you are @Condition[flanked], and so long as you have @Rule[resource.focus] to spend it costs only @Rule[resource.focus]{1 Focus} instead of an @Rule[resource.action].

Challenge.name: Challenge
Challenge.description:
You single out a worthy foe, binding them to a duel through the sheer force of your presence. The target becomes your Challenged rival until Combat ends, until they are defeated, or until you Challenge a different foe. You may have only one Challenged rival at a time.

While your Challenged rival is the only enemy you are engaged with, your immersion in the duel deepens: at the end of each of your turns you gain stacking +1 Bonus Damage to your melee Strikes against that rival, to a maximum equal to your @Rule[ability.presence]. This bonus resets to zero if the duel is broken, which happens if another enemy engages you, if your rival escapes your @Rule[movement.engagement], or if you Strike any other creature.

Channeled Resonance.name: Channeled Resonance
Channeled Resonance.description: A great implement held in both hands hums in sympathy with the magic you sustain through it. While you are wielding a two-handed Talisman and maintaining an effect which costs @Rule[resource.focus], your Talisman attacks deal +2 damage.

Channeler's Grip.name: Channeler's Grip
Channeler's Grip.description: Your hold upon your implement is so assured that a single hand suffices for workings which ought to demand two. While wielding a one-handed Talisman you may cast spells which require two hands, no matter what occupies your other hand.

Charged Bolt.name: Charged Bolt
Charged Bolt.description: You pour a measure of your reserves into a single searing bolt, striking far harder than your implement alone could manage.

Charged Bolt.name: Charged Bolt
Charged Bolt.description: You perform an @Rule[action.empowered] Talisman attack against a single target.

Chastening Blow.name: Chastening Blow
Chastening Blow.description: You have learned to strike without killing. A rap with the pommel, the flat of the blade turned at the last moment, a blow placed precisely where it will humble rather than harm.

Chastening Blow.name: Chastening Blow
Chastening Blow.description: You perform a deliberately non-lethal weapon Strike which deals its damage to the target's @Rule[resource.morale] rather than their @Rule[resource.health].

Chirurgeon.name: Chirurgeon
Chirurgeon.description: Your improvisational expertise with battlefield medicine can save many lives. You make all @Rule[skill.medicine] checks during combat with @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon}.

Medicinal Compound.name: Medicinal Compound
Medicinal Compound.description:
You delve into your medical supplies, hastily combining whatever you might have available to salve the target's wounds or calm the target's mind. Perform a @Rule[skill.medicine]{Medicine Check}.

The attempt is contested by the higher of the target's @Rule[defense.wounds] or @Rule[defense.madness]. If successful the target immediately regains both @Rule[resource.health] and @Rule[resource.morale] as well as half that amount at the beginning of each of their subsequent 3 Turns.

Clarify Intent.name: Clarify Intent
Clarify Intent.description: You use apply your situational awareness and persuasiveness to rapidly communicate a plan of action to an ally.

Clarify Intent.name: Clarify Intent
Clarify Intent.description: You explain your intentions to an ally within 12 feet. Make an @Rule[skill.diplomacy] Skill attack against your ally's @Rule[defense.madness]. If successful they gain @Rule[resource.focus]{+1 Focus} and @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} to actions made during their next turn.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: This martial technique is a specialized two-handed fighting maneuver which relies upon brute strength to swing your weapon in a wide arc, hitting multiple enemies in its path.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: A ferocious two-handed swing cleaves through foes in a 120 degree arc.

Coldwork.name: Coldwork
Coldwork.description: Years at the anvil teach a smith to read iron the way a scholar reads a page. You know where a fitting was welded, where it has been mended, and where it will give.

Coldwork.name: Coldwork
Coldwork.condition: You have a Smith's Toolkit equipped.
Coldwork.description:
You know metal by feel: where it was worked, where it has been mended, and where a single blow will part it. With a Smith's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by @Rule[skill.smithing] which you can clearly see within 30 feet, learning its Quality tier and whether it is Broken. You learn nothing of its enchantment, its affixes, or its history.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously sunder a non-magical iron or steel fitting no thicker than your thumb which you can physically touch, such as a chain link, a padlock, or a manacle, or a non-magical weapon, shield, or suit of armor in your possession which is not equipped, striking where it was welded, pinned, or tempered. Alternatively you may spend 10 minutes to sabotage such a work of iron or steel. You name the condition under which it fails; when that condition is met, the Gamemaster decides the consequences. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional @Rule[skill.awareness] check which beats your passive @Rule[skill.smithing].

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to materials, you may forge any small work of iron or steel you are familiar with: a working copy of a non-magical key which you hold, a set of climbing spikes, a scatter of caltrops, a grapple hook. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully forge any such work outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Combat Medicine.name: Combat Medicine
Combat Medicine.description: Your knowledge and skill in @Rule[skill.medicine] covers the rapid triage, diagnosis, and treatment of wounds.

Combat Medicine.name: Combat Medicine
Combat Medicine.description: You rapidly treat the wounds of an ally within 4 feet. Perform a @Rule[skill.medicine]{Medicine Check} against the target's @Rule[defense.wounds]. Your ally's @Rule[resource.health] is increased by overflow of the check.

Comforting Lie.name: Comforting Lie
Comforting Lie.description: The wound is not so deep. The bridge will hold. Help is closer than it looks. You tell your companion whatever they need to believe, and you carry the weight of knowing better.

Comforting Lie.name: Comforting Lie
Comforting Lie.description: You reassure an ally with a falsehood you know to be untrue, making a @Rule[skill.deception] check against their @Rule[defense.madness]. Upon a success they recover @Rule[resource.morale] equal to the overflow of the check. Should they see through your fiction, you lose @Rule[resource.morale] equal to the amount by which your check fell short.

Compelling Illusion.name: Compelling Illusion
Compelling Illusion.description: To you, the key to a successful illusion is not in its meticulous construction, but in the conviction of your self-belief. Your usage of the Rune of Illusion scales with @Rule[ability.presence] instead of @Rule[ability.intellect].

Concussive Blows.name: Concussive Blows
Concussive Blows.description:
Your physical power wielding melee weapons which deal Bludgeoning damage can cause the @Condition[staggered] condition on @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage to @Rule[resource.health].

The @Condition[staggered] effect lasts for 1 Round and reduces your target's maximum @Rule[resource.action] by 2.

Conjurer.name: Conjurer
Conjurer.description: You are a master of using the Gestures of Conjuration and Creation to manifest arcane energy as physical form. You can maintain up to 3 such creations simultaneously rather than only one.

Conserve Effort.name: Conserve Effort
Conserve Effort.description: You find calmness and focus in conserving your effort in battle. When you end your turn with un-spent @Rule[resource.action] you gain @Rule[resource.focus]{+1 Focus}.

Counter Evade.name: Counter Evade
Counter Evade.description: You are practiced in evasive fighting styles which use an enemy's missed attack to devise an opening to counter-attack.

Counter Evade.name: Counter Evade
Counter Evade.condition: You Dodge an incoming melee Strike.
Counter Evade.description: When you defend against a melee attack with a @Rule[defense.dodge], you may expend @Rule[resource.focus] to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using your mainhand weapon.

Counter Riposte.name: Counter Riposte
Counter Riposte.description: You are expert in translating a parried attack into a swift counter against your exposed enemy.

Counter Riposte.name: Counter Riposte
Counter Riposte.condition: You Parry an incoming melee Strike.
Counter Riposte.description: When you defend against a melee attack with a @Rule[defense.parry], you may react and expend @Rule[resource.focus] to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike which is @Rule[action.accurate].

Counter Strike.name: Counter Strike
Counter Strike.description: You are trained to transition between defending with your shield and a swift counter-attack.

Counter Strike.name: Counter Strike
Counter Strike.condition: You Block an incoming melee Strike.
Counter Strike.description: When you defend against a melee attack with a @Rule[defense.block] you may expend @Rule[resource.focus] to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using a melee weapon.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: You immediately react to a spell being cast and compose a rune and gesture designed to unravel and negate the spellcraft of an enemy mage.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.condition: Another creature which you can see is casting a spell.
Counterspell.description:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to your attempt.

Perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Spell attack against your target's @Rule[defense.willpower] defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.

Decisive Action.name: Decisive Action
Decisive Action.description: Your sharpened mind thinks quickly amidst the maelstrom of combat, identifying and seizing opportunities the moment they appear.

Decisive Action.name: Decisive Action
Decisive Action.description: You expend @Rule[resource.heroism] to instantly recover half your @Rule[ability.intellect] in @Rule[resource.action]. You may perform this action outside of your turn in Combat before making a @Rule[action.reaction].

Defensive Roll.name: Defensive Roll
Defensive Roll.description: You are a nimble skirmisher, always in movement to stay one step ahead of your enemies in combat.

Defensive Roll.name: Defensive Roll
Defensive Roll.condition: You Dodge an incoming melee Strike.
Defensive Roll.description: When you @Rule[defense.dodge] a melee attack you can expend @Rule[resource.focus] to leap into a defensive roll, moving up to your @Rule[movement.size] in any direction.

Defiant Will.name: Defiant Will
Defiant Will.description: As your body weakens, your mind hardens. You gain bonus @Rule[defense.willpower] defense equal to your @Rule[ability.toughness] score scaled by the proportion of @Rule[resource.health] you have lost.

Deft Grip.name: Deft Grip
Deft Grip.description:
Your grasp of your weaponry is fluid and precise. While wielding a two-handed weapon that scales with @Rule[ability.dexterity] you may cast spells which require two hands, and attempts to Disarm you are made with @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes}.

Additionally, you may use your @Rule[movement.freeMovement] to equip or unequip such a weapon without any @Rule[resource.action] cost.

Demolitionist.name: Demolitionist
Demolitionist.description:
Your remarkable expertise with munitions allows you to wield them efficiently amidst the chaos of combat. Each turn, your first usage of a Bomb has a reduced cost of @Rule[resource.action]{-1 Action}.

You are no longer targeted by your own bombs, even if you are otherwise within their area of effect.

Dependable Refocus.name: Dependable Refocus
Dependable Refocus.description: Practice has made the work of drawing your reserves back into yourself steady and sure. Your @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.refocus000000000 refocus] action gains the @Rule[action.accurate] and @Rule[action.keen] tags.

Dervish.name: Dervish
Dervish.description: You are specialized in fighting with two weapons. In combat you become a whirlwind of weapons, deadly to any foes who approach.

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
Whirlwind.description: You become a cyclone of whirling weaponry, making Strike attacks with both weapons against every enemy within range.

Dig In.name: Dig In
Dig In.description: You have been at the end of your rope before and you know the shape of it. The first time in a Combat encounter that an attack would reduce you to zero @Rule[resource.morale] and leave you @Condition[broken], you are only reduced to @Rule[resource.morale]{1 Morale} instead.

Dirty Tricks.name: Dirty Tricks
Dirty Tricks.description: You know how to turn the dirt beneath your feet into a weapon. Whether flung from a pouch of sand, scooped up in a handful, or kicked up from the earth, a well-placed spray of grit can temporarily distract or blind an enemy.

Dirty Tricks.name: Dirty Tricks
Dirty Tricks.description: You fling debris into the eyes of an enemy. If the Strike is successful, they are @Condition[blinded] until the end of their next Turn.

Disarming Riposte.name: Disarming Riposte
Disarming Riposte.description: Your ripostes are precise enough to strip a weapon from your foe's grasp. When your @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.counterriposte00]{Counter Riposte} achieves a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit}, the target is disarmed, dropping their main-hand weapon.

Disarming Strike.name: Disarming Strike
Disarming Strike.description: A martial technique designed to disarm your opponent, forcing them to drop an object held in their main hand.

Disarming Strike.name: Disarming Strike
Disarming Strike.description: You make a Strike against a the @Rule[defense.reflex] defense of a single target. The technique is @Rule[action.difficult] to perform and deals @Rule[action.weakened] damage. If successful, the target's mainhand weapon is Dropped.

Distance Runner.name: Distance Runner
Distance Runner.description: You are adept at covering distance quickly. Your @Rule[movement.stride] increases by 1.

Diversionist.name: Diversionist
Diversionist.description: You specialize in using subterfuge to distract or trick your opponent during combat.

Distract.name: Distract
Distract.description: You make a @Rule[skill.deception] based Skill Attack against the @Rule[defense.willpower] defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses @Rule[resource.focus]{1 Focus}.

Dread Lord.name: Dread Lord
Dread Lord.description: You exude a terrible presence on the battlefield which tests the morale of nearby enemies that behold you, breaking the resolve of the weak-willed.

Formidable Presence.name: Formidable Presence
Formidable Presence.description: You make an @Rule[skill.intimidation] skill attack against the @Rule[defense.willpower] defense of enemies within 12 feet, dealing Void damage to @Rule[resource.morale] and causing the @Condition[frightened] condition for 1 Round to those whose defense you overcome.

Dual Wield.name: Dual Wield
Dual Wield.description: You are adept at fighting with two weapons simultaneously. You can weave attacks together to strike more rapidly than possible with a single weapon.

Offhand Strike.name: Offhand Strike
Offhand Strike.description: Immediately after you perform a basic @Action[default strike] with your mainhand weapon, you make a reduced-cost follow-up Strike with your offhand weapon.

Duelist.name: Duelist
Duelist.description:
You relish the thrill and skillful mastery of single combat, employing a fighting style that uses a one-handed weapon while keeping your off-hand unoccupied.

While wielding a one-handed melee weapon with your other hand empty, you gain a +2 bonus to your @Rule[defense.parry] defense. While meeting these criteria, any attack that results in a Glance against your @Rule[defense.armor] becomes a Parry instead. These benefits do not apply against an attacker who has you @Condition[flanked].

Estocade.name: Estocade
Estocade.description:
You deliver a precise, decisive thrust against a foe you have caught at a disadvantage. You make a Strike with your main-hand weapon which is @Rule[action.empowered] and @Rule[action.keen].

You may only perform this attack against a target who is @Condition[exposed], @Condition[prone], @Condition[slowed], @Condition[staggered], @Condition[paralyzed] or who has been disarmed of their main-hand weapon.

Dustbinder.name: Dustbinder
Dustbinder.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Earth. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[corroding] condition.

The Corroding effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals half the ability score your Rune of Earth scales with as Acid damage to @Rule[resource.health] each Round.

Eldritch Bargain.name: Eldritch Bargain
Eldritch Bargain.description: There are older things than Runes, and they can lend power. When you have no @Rule[resource.focus] remaining, you may spend @Rule[resource.morale] in its place. Each point of insufficient @Rule[resource.focus] costs @Rule[resource.morale]{10 Morale} in exchange. You may still make this exchange while otherwise prevented from spending @Rule[resource.focus], for example by the @Condition[broken] condition, although such a trade may incur @Rule[resource.madness].

Evasive Armor.name: Evasive Armor
Evasive Armor.description: You are fast enough to lean into blows and take them on your armor's strongest points. Any @Rule[defense.reflex] defense in excess of your @Rule[defense.physical] defense is added as bonus @Rule[defense.armor].

Evasive Shot.name: Evasive Shot
Evasive Shot.description: You are an expert at firing shots with ranged weaponry while evading enemy attacks.

Evasive Shot.name: Evasive Shot
Evasive Shot.description: After performing a ranged weapon attack, you may move up to half your @Rule[movement.stride] for free.

Executioner's Strike.name: Executioner's Strike
Executioner's Strike.description: You deliver a single decisive strike against a wounded enemy.

Executioner's Strike.name: Executioner's Strike
Executioner's Strike.description: You deliver a Strike with a two-handed weapon. If your attack is successful and your opponent is under half their maximum @Rule[resource.health], the strike is @Rule[action.deadly], and the opponent suffers the @Condition[bleeding] condition for 3 Rounds, taking additional damage each round equal to your @Rule[ability.strength] score.

Expeditious Illumination.name: Expeditious Illumination
Expeditious Illumination.description: You manifest illumination with a speed almost rivaling that of the light itself, deploying it precisely where and when it will have the greatest effect. Your usage of the Rune of Illumination scales with @Rule[ability.intellect] instead of @Rule[ability.presence].

Exploit Despair.name: Exploit Despair
Exploit Despair.description: A foe who has lost heart becomes timid or uncertain, a flinch before parrying or a guard raised too late. You can identify and punish these openings. Your attacks against a @Condition[broken] creature are made with @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon}.

Extoll Deeds.name: Extoll Deeds
Extoll Deeds.description: You inspire courage within your allies by extolling the heroic deeds of a companion. You may react by composing a verse, making a quip, or shouting a battle cry when an ally you can see scores a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} against an enemy creature or renders one @Condition[incapacitated]. The celebration of these heroic deeds restores the @Rule[resource.morale] of your allies within 10 feet.

Extoll Deeds.name: Extoll Deeds
Extoll Deeds.condition: An ally whom you can see slays an enemy or achieves a Critical Success.
Extoll Deeds.description: You compose a verse, make a quip, or shout a battle cry to extoll the heroic deeds of one of your allies. All allies near to you regain @Rule[resource.morale] equal to half your @Rule[ability.presence] score.

Eye of the Storm.name: Eye of the Storm
Eye of the Storm.description: After you @Action[default delay] your turn, gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} on any Strike or Spell attack against an enemy that you allowed to act before you that round.

Fan of Arrows.name: Fan of Arrows
Fan of Arrows.description: This @Rule[action.difficult] ranged weaponry technique allows you to fire a multiple shots with your weapon in a sweeping cone, each targeting a different enemy in the area of effect.

Fan of Arrows.name: Fan of Arrows
Fan of Arrows.description: You fire multiple projectiles from your ranged weapon in an arc, striking all enemy targets within a 40 foot cone.

Feinting Strike.name: Feinting Strike
Feinting Strike.description: A two-weapon technique which makes a feint with your primary weapon, exposing your target for an @Rule[action.offhand] attack.

Feinting Strike.name: Feinting Strike
Feinting Strike.description:
You feint with your mainhand weapon, making a @Rule[skill.deception] attack against the target's @Rule[defense.reflex] defense. You immediately make a Strike with your offhand weapon.

If your deception was successful, you gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to your Strike and it deals an additional +6 Damage.

Feral Brawler.name: Feral Brawler
Feral Brawler.description:
You fight with your bare hands the way a beast fights with claw and jaw, committing to a savagery that trained fighters are taught out of.

Your bare hands count as Natural weapons in addition to Unarmed ones. You may use them for any action which requires a Natural weapon, and they are wielded using whichever of your Natural or Unarmed proficiencies serves you better.

Ferocious Leap.name: Ferocious Leap
Ferocious Leap.description: You leap powerfully into battle to deliver a punishing blow to a nearby enemy with your mainhand weapon.

Ferocious Leap.name: Ferocious Leap
Ferocious Leap.description: You Jump up to 10 feet, delivering a Strike against an enemy within melee range of where you land. Your movement ignores difficult terrain and is not blocked by enemy creatures.

Field Concoction.name: Field Concoction
Field Concoction.description:
Others need a laboratory. You need a fire, a flat rock, and whatever the roadside provided.

You may perform alchemical crafting without a facility, though attempts made without one are @Rule[action.difficult]. You may include one ingredient in a recipe which is a single quality tier lower than that recipe calls for without penalty.

Playtest Notes

The crafting system is in early development. This talent describes how Alchemy will behave once facilities and ingredient quality are enforced.

Filigree.name: Filigree
Filigree.description: Your eye is exact and your hand is steady. You can judge a rough stone across a table and tell what it will become once you have had it a while.

Filigree.name: Filigree
Filigree.condition: You have a Jeweler's Toolkit equipped.
Filigree.description:
Every stone has a grain and a flaw. With a Jeweler's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study a gemstone, or an item created by @Rule[skill.jewelcraft], which you can handle, learning its Quality tier, whether its stones are genuine or paste, whether any has been replaced since it was made, and what it is honestly worth.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously strike the flaw in a non-magical gemstone or ornament which you can physically touch, shattering it into fragments worth nothing. Alternatively, in the course of setting a stone yourself, you may seat it so that it works loose and is lost under a condition you name. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional @Rule[skill.awareness] check which beats your passive @Rule[skill.jewelcraft].

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to materials, you may make any small work of fine metal or stone you can picture: a puzzle box which opens one way only, a locket with a compartment nobody would find, a signet cut to match a seal you have handled, a clockwork bird that sings once when wound, spectacles ground to one particular pair of eyes. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully make any such trinket outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Flaming Arrow.name: Flaming Arrow
Flaming Arrow.description: You take time to light and loose an arrow covered in flammable pitch. This shot takes longer but is very damaging to creatures and structures.

Flaming Arrow.name: Flaming Arrow
Flaming Arrow.description: You loose an @Rule[action.empowered] ranged strike using a Projectile weapon which deals Fire damage upon impact.

Flash Frost.name: Flash Frost
Flash Frost.description: You freeze with the speed of thought, creating cold that arrives all at once. Your usage of the Rune of Frost scales with @Rule[ability.intellect] instead of @Rule[ability.wisdom].

Flash of Steel.name: Flash of Steel
Flash of Steel.description: You are an expert in using a thrown weapon to unbalance or expose your target for follow-up strikes.

Flash of Steel.name: Flash of Steel
Flash of Steel.description: You make a Thrown weapon attack, targeting a weak point in your enemy's defenses. If the attack hits, the target becomes @Condition[exposed] until the start of their next turn.

Fletcher's Mending.name: Fletcher's Mending
Fletcher's Mending.description:
You have straightened enough warped staves and rebuilt enough ruined shafts to know that wood asks only to be given back its line.

The repairs you make using the @Rule[skill.fletching] trade benefit from Expert Repair:

  • You may attempt such repairs without a workbench, though attempts made without one are @Rule[action.difficult].

  • A repair you succeed at never costs the item a Quality tier.

Playtest Notes

Repair is not yet automated. The rules it follows are described in the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.repair0000000000]{Repair} journal.

Flourish.name: Flourish
Flourish.description:
You have drilled the showy cuts that duelists perform for a crowd. Directed towards your opponent, the display advertises how dangerous you are, causing them to worry whether it is true.

A steady opponent reads the motion as empty theatre, an enemy who flinches imagines the point of your blade.

Flourish.name: Flourish
Flourish.description: You demonstrate a rapid maneuver of bladework, performing a @Rule[skill.performance] skill attack against their @Rule[defense.reflex] defense. Upon a success they sustain Piercing damage to their @Rule[resource.morale].

Flurry.name: Flurry
Flurry.description: A martial technique using two weapons to overwhelm a single target with a relentless sequence of attacks.

Flurry.name: Flurry
Flurry.description: You Strike twice with each weapon, but each strike is @Rule[action.difficult].

Flying Kick.name: Flying Kick
Flying Kick.description: An unarmed technique where you launch yourself while running at an enemy in a leaping kick which is @Rule[action.empowered] to deal additional damage.

Flying Kick.name: Flying Kick
Flying Kick.description: Move forward at least 3 feet and up to your @Rule[movement.stride] in a straight line to kick an enemy with an @Rule[action.empowered] Strike.

Focal Reach.name: Focal Reach
Focal Reach.description: You project your will through your implement across great distance. The maximum range of your Talisman attacks is increased by an amount equal to your current @Rule[resource.focus].

Focused Anticipation.name: Focused Anticipation
Focused Anticipation.description: Anticipation leads to decisive action. When you have the highest Initiative score for a round of combat, you gain @Rule[resource.focus]{+1 Focus}.

Forensic Reconstruction.name: Forensic Reconstruction
Forensic Reconstruction.description: You treat a room as a body of evidence. Dust disturbed and dust undisturbed, the angle of a dropped object, a scuff running the wrong way, the one thing that ought to be here and is not: you assemble such facts into an account of what happened.

Reconstruct.name: Reconstruct
Reconstruct.description:
Name aloud a theory of what happened in this place. If the Gamemaster judges that the place could bear your theory out or contradict it, perform an @Rule[skill.awareness] check against DC 14.

  • @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} if your theory follows from evidence you have already gathered.

  • @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes} if it is conjecture, or if the place has been cleaned, trampled, or reoccupied since.

Upon a Success you deduce one true thing bearing upon your theory, which may support or refute it. Upon a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] you deduce a second, which the Gamemaster may draw from what your theory did not think to ask.

A theory may only be investigated once. A failed investigation does not mean the theory is incorrect, only that no corroborating evidence was found.

The place answers in physical fact alone: it never names a culprit, a motive, or a word that was spoken.

Fulcrum.name: Fulcrum
Fulcrum.description: Balance, positioning, and leverage are your greatest allies in combat. You know how to use a foe's momentum against them and that a small redirection in force can turn the tide of battle.

Conserve Momentum.name: Conserve Momentum
Conserve Momentum.condition: You Block, Parry, or Dodge an incoming melee Strike.
Conserve Momentum.description:
You redirect the force of a melee attack which misses you, pivoting it to instead hit some other adjacent enemy. Your attacker must re-roll their attack targeting their ally instead.

Playtest Notes

This action is not yet automated.

Gallows Humor.name: Gallows Humor
Gallows Humor.description: Disaster is easier borne when someone makes light of it. You have a remark ready for the worst moments, and it lands exactly when it is needed.

Gallows Humor.name: Gallows Humor
Gallows Humor.condition: An ally whom you can see becomes Weakened or suffers a Critical Failure.
Gallows Humor.description: You may react to an ally's @Rule[dice.criticalFailure] with a grim joke at their expense or your own, restoring their @Rule[resource.morale] by half of your @Rule[ability.presence] score.

Gambit.name: Gambit
Gambit.description:
You fight by the odds and every exchange is a wager. You read your opponent's intent, make risky bets to goad them into overcommitting, then stake everything on a game-changing payout. You trust your gut, wits, and some arcane chicanery to tilt the odds in your favor, gaining the following benefits:

  • The Tell. You see a blow before it is thrown. Your @Rule[defense.dodge] defense is calculated using your @Rule[ability.intellect] instead of @Rule[ability.dexterity], if your @Rule[ability.intellect] is higher.

  • Loaded Dice. Fortune bends to those who help it along. Once per round, the first time you roll a 1 on any die, that die is rerolled and you keep the new result.

  • Ante Up. When you make a @Action[default strike], you can choose to wager additional @Rule[dice.bane]{Banes} against yourself. If the Strike hits an enemy, you gain Gambit charges equal to the number of @Rule[dice.bane]{Banes} you wagered. These charges accumulate until the end of Combat or until spent.

All-In.name: All-In
All-In.description: Every gamble you have made comes due, and you collect all at once. The next attack or check you make this turn rolls the maximum possible result on every die in its pool. If that action makes more than one roll, only the first is maximized. You can activate this action by spending either 6 Gambit charges or @Rule[resource.heroism]{1 Heroism}.

Gathering Storm.name: Gathering Storm
Gathering Storm.description: You understand that a storm is not sudden chaos but a patient, gathering force that breaks only when it must. Your usage of the Rune of Storm scales with @Rule[ability.wisdom] instead of @Rule[ability.intellect].

Gesture: Arrow.name: Gesture: Arrow
Gesture: Arrow.description:
You hurl a projectile imbued with the magical power of a Rune at a distant target.

The Arrow gesture scales using @Rule[ability.intellect] and targets a single creature up to a distance of 60 feet, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Aspect.name: Gesture: Aspect
Gesture: Aspect.description:
You infuse the essence of a Rune into your body, empowering your own physical form or psyche.

When you assume a certain Aspect, you become more closely attuned to the damage type of the Rune used in your spell. You gain +2 Resistance to that damage type, and deal an additional +2 Damage whenever dealing damage of that type.

Your Aspect lasts for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Aspect; casting another spell using the Aspect gesture replaces the previous effect. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Aura.name: Gesture: Aura
Gesture: Aura.description:
You concentrate the arcane power of a Rune to create a maintained field of energy that washes over allies or enemies near to you.

The Aura gesture scales with @Rule[ability.presence] and produces an emanation with 20 feet radius centered on the spellcaster. The center of this Aura moves with the spellcaster. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast, has a base cost of 5 Action and 1 Focus, and must be @Rule[action.maintained] costing an additional 1 Focus every subsequent round.

When a creature starts its Turn or enters the area of your aura, they are targeted by a Spell Attack which causes either damage or healing depending on which Rune was used for this spell. This attack deals 6 Base Damage, and its defense type and damage type are also determined by its Rune.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Blast.name: Gesture: Blast
Gesture: Blast.description:
You hurl the arcane power of a Rune into an intense explosion of energy at a nearby point you can see.

The Blast gesture scales with @Rule[ability.intellect] and produces a blast with a 6 foot radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the spellcaster. The blast deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Cone.name: Gesture: Cone
Gesture: Cone.description:
You focus the arcane power of a Rune into a narrow cone that projects outwards from your location.

The Cone gesture scales with @Rule[ability.intellect] and produces a 60 degree cone with a 30 foot radius originating from the spellcaster. The Cone deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Conjure.name: Gesture: Conjure
Gesture: Conjure.description:
You coalesce arcane power into a superior form, manifesting a Visitor which appears within 30 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Visitor is a Minion equal to your own Level.

The Conjure gesture scales with @Rule[ability.wisdom] and the Visitor survives for 12 Rounds. You may only have one active Visitor. Casting another spell using the Conjure gesture replaces your previous Visitor. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast, has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus, and must be @Rule[action.maintained] costing an additional 1 Focus every subsequent round.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Not all Runes have a Visitor actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Conjuration will — for now — manifest a @UUID[Compendium.crucible.summons.Actor.AlwoqQKoL1BnnZjd].

Gesture: Create.name: Gesture: Create
Gesture: Create.description:
You coalesce arcane power into tangible form, manifesting a Sprite which appears within 10 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Sprite is a Minion of half your own Level.

The Create gesture scales with @Rule[ability.wisdom] and the Sprite survives for 6 Rounds. You may only have one active Sprite; casting another spell using the Create gesture replaces your previous Sprite. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

Not all Runes have a Sprite actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Creation will — for now — manifest a@UUID[Compendium.crucible.summons.Actor.RuNh1bFGiHKdHeKI].

Gesture: Fan.name: Gesture: Fan
Gesture: Fan.description:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using @Rule[ability.intellect] and targets a 120 degree arc with a 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Influence.name: Gesture: Influence
Gesture: Influence.description:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using @Rule[ability.presence] and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Pulse.name: Gesture: Pulse
Gesture: Pulse.description:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using @Rule[ability.presence] and produces an emanation with a 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Ray.name: Gesture: Ray
Gesture: Ray.description:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using @Rule[ability.wisdom] and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Sense.name: Gesture: Sense
Gesture: Sense.description:
You attune your mind to the arcane power of a Rune to sense nearby sources of energy.

The Sense gesture scales with @Rule[ability.presence] and produces an emanation with 30 feet radius and position that remains centered upon the spellcaster. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus. It may optionally be @Rule[action.maintained] at the additional cost of 1 Focus every subsequent round.

This spell allows the caster to detect the presence of spellcraft using the same Rune as the one incorporated in this spell. The sense will also momentarily detect the presence of creatures according to their type.

  • Control: Fiends

  • Death: Undead

  • Earth: Oozes and Earth Elementals

  • Flame: Dragons and Fire Elementals

  • Frost: Giants and Frost Elementals

  • Illumination: Celestials

  • Illusion: Fey

  • Kinesis: Monstrosities

  • Life: Plants and Beasts

  • Storm: Constructs and Storm Elementals

  • Oblivion: Outsiders

  • Soul: Humanoids

Gesture: Step.name: Gesture: Step
Gesture: Step.description:
You infuse runic power into a movement, crossing physical and spatial boundaries.

The Step gesture scales with @Rule[ability.dexterity] and allows you to move up to 20 feet in a straight line with width equal to your @Rule[movement.size]. It deals 2 Base Damage to targets along that line which fail to resist the spell. This gesture does not require any free hands to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Gesture: Strike.name: Gesture: Strike
Gesture: Strike.description:
You empower a direct close-range attack with the arcane essence of a Rune, performing a Strike with your equipped weapon.

The Strike gesture scales using @Rule[ability.strength] and deal damage based on your used weapon but with the damage type of the incorporated Rune. This gesture does not require any free hand and has a base cost of 1 Focus in addition to the @Rule[resource.action] cost of your weapon Strike.

Gesture: Surge.name: Gesture: Surge
Gesture: Surge.description:
You channel the arcane power of a Rune into a rushing wave of energy that surges forward from your current position.

The Surge gesture scales with @Rule[ability.wisdom] and produces a line that is 10 feet wide and 15 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Gesture: Ward.name: Gesture: Ward
Gesture: Ward.description:
You shape the arcane power of a Rune into a protective barrier used to shield yourself from harm.

The Ward gesture scales using @Rule[ability.toughness] and provides +6 Resistance against the damage type of the Rune used in the spell. This resistance lasts for 1 Round and you may only have a single Ward at a time. Casting another spell using the Ward gesture replaces your prior Ward. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 2 Action and 1 Focus.

Gladiator.name: Gladiator
Gladiator.description: Once per Round, you can make a @Rule[action.reaction] which incorporates a Strike attack without spending any @Rule[resource.focus].

Grainwork.name: Grainwork
Grainwork.description: Wood is never uniform. You read the grain the way another reads a page, and you know that every stave, haft, and shaft holds one line along which it wants to part.

Grainwork.name: Grainwork
Grainwork.condition: You have a Fletcher's Toolkit equipped.
Grainwork.description:
Wood tells you where it grew, how it was seasoned, and where it will give. With a Fletcher's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by @Rule[skill.fletching] which you can clearly see within 30 feet, learning its Quality tier, whether it is Broken, and whether its wood was properly seasoned. From a projectile lodged in a body or a surface you also learn the direction it was loosed from and how far it flew. You learn nothing of enchantment, affixes, or history.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously split a non-magical wooden object along its grain, whether a fixture which you can physically touch such as a door bar, a ladder rung, or a cart axle, or a wooden weapon, shield, or talisman in your possession which is not equipped, parting it in one silent motion where an axe would want a minute and a great deal of noise. Alternatively you may spend 10 minutes to sabotage such a work of wood. You name the condition under which it fails; when that condition is met, the Gamemaster decides the consequences. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional @Rule[skill.awareness] check which beats your passive @Rule[skill.fletching].

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to sound wood, you may fashion any work of wood you are familiar with: a brace which holds a door or shores a sagging beam, a replacement spoke, oar, or axle pin which returns a vehicle to travel, a fistful of arrows cut green which fly true for one battle before they warp. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully fashion any such work outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Grapple.name: Grapple
Grapple.description: You are familiar with basic martial arts and hand-to-hand combat. You know how to subdue or restrain opponents using your physical strength.

Grapple.name: Grapple
Grapple.description: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform an @Rule[skill.athletics] skill attack against an adjacent target contested by their passive @Rule[skill.athletics] skill. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.

Hamstring.name: Hamstring
Hamstring.description: You use a slashing weapon to target the legs of an enemy and cripple their movement.

Hamstring.name: Hamstring
Hamstring.description: You make Strike attack which is @Rule[action.difficult], but if successful, inflicts the @Condition[slowed] condition for 3 Rounds.

Harrier.name: Harrier
Harrier.description: You hound enemies who would rather fight you from afar. You may make a @Action[default reactiveStrike] against an enemy engaged with you whenever they make an attack that is not tagged as Melee.

Headbutt.name: Headbutt
Headbutt.description: You can deliver a brutal close-range strike with your head that catches opponents off-guard.

Headbutt.name: Headbutt
Headbutt.description:
Make an unarmed Strike against the @Rule[defense.fortitude] defense of an adjacent enemy. If your Initiative is superior to that of your target, you gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} to this attack.

The attack is @Rule[action.difficult] and only deals @Rule[action.weakened] damage, but if successful it inflicts the @Condition[staggered] for 1 Round.

This action always uses an Unarmed weapon, even if your weapon slots are otherwise occupied.

Healer.name: Healer
Healer.description: You are unparalleled at manipulating vital arcana to treat injuries. You learn Rune: Life if you do not already know it. When healing allies using the Rune of Life you gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to your roll.

Font of Life.name: Font of Life
Font of Life.description: You bring forth an aura of life-giving magic. Immediately upon activation and for the next 3 Rounds, whenever an ally first enters or starts their turn within 20 feet of you, they regain @Rule[resource.health] equal to your @Rule[ability.wisdom] score.

Hearthwork.name: Hearthwork
Hearthwork.description: You are the one who makes sure everyone has eaten. A hot bowl pressed into the hands of a companion at the end of a bad day is the whole of your craft, and you have never let one go to sleep hungry.

Hearthwork.name: Hearthwork
Hearthwork.condition: You have a Cook's Toolkit equipped.
Hearthwork.description:
Food carries the history of what was done to it. With a Cook's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by cooking which you can clearly see within 30 feet, learning its Quality tier, whether it has spoiled, and what has been added to it. When you eat something prepared by another hand, you learn its recipe.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously spoil non-magical food or drink which you can physically touch, turning a dish, a cask, or a company's rations rancid beyond salvage. Alternatively, in the course of preparing food or drink yourself, you may sabotage it while leaving it looking and smelling wholesome. You name the condition under which it fails; when that condition is met, the Gamemaster decides the consequences. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional @Rule[skill.awareness] check which beats your passive @Rule[skill.cooking].

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to ingredients, you may prepare any food or drink you are familiar with and have it come out as you intended, from field porridge to a wedding cake to a cordial you tasted once in another country. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully prepare any dish outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Heavy Strike.name: Heavy Strike
Heavy Strike.description: You know how to use a heavy weapon to deliver punishing blows, putting your entire strength behind every swing.

Heavy Strike.name: Heavy Strike
Heavy Strike.description: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is @Rule[action.empowered] to deliver additional damage.

Hide.name: Hide
Hide.description:
You use cover, shadow, and stillness to drop out of sight entirely, to avoid detection or to lay in ambush.

Playtest Notes

The Stealth check resolves, marks you concealed, and that concealment ends on its own once you act without the @Rule[action.subtle] tag. Your Stealth result is recorded, so anyone who later @Action[default search]es for you tests their Awareness against it. Crucible does not yet record which creatures individually have lost track of you, so beating one observer conceals you from all of them and the Gamemaster adjudicates the difference. A forthcoming stealth effect will track detection per creature.

Hide.name: Hide
Hide.description: You make a single @Rule[skill.stealth] check against the passive @Rule[skill.awareness] of the most perceptive enemy within 30 feet, taking @Rule[dice.bane]{+1 Bane} for each further enemy who might notice you. With no enemy near enough to notice you no check is required. Upon a success you are concealed until you perform an action which is not @Rule[action.subtle].

Hold Fast.name: Hold Fast
Hold Fast.description: You are a calm anchor in the swirling sea of combat. When you have a Shield equipped, your @Rule[movement.engagement] increases by +1, allowing you to simultaneously engage more adjacent foes.

Hulking Physique.name: Hulking Physique
Hulking Physique.description: Your hulking frame swells with raw mass. Your @Rule[movement.size] increases by 1, but your bulk slows you: your @Rule[movement.stride] and @Rule[defense.dodge] defense each decrease by 2.

Impenetrable Guard.name: Impenetrable Guard
Impenetrable Guard.description: Your defenses frustrate attackers who struggle to find a gap in your guard. When an enemy's Strike against you results in a @Rule[defense.block] or Glancing Blow, that enemy suffers @Rule[dice.bane]{+1 Bane} on their next Strike against you.

Impetus.name: Impetus
Impetus.description: You are gifted at exploiting the slowness with which others think. If you are first in Initiative order during a round of Combat, you gain +1 current and maximum @Rule[resource.action].

Inexorable Flame.name: Inexorable Flame
Inexorable Flame.description: You recognize that fire can spread with inevitable and unstoppable purpose. Your usage of the Rune of Flame scales with @Rule[ability.wisdom] instead of @Rule[ability.intellect].

Infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
Infiltrator.description:
You have mastered traditional stealth, using shadow and cover to slip the notice of watchful sentries. When you use @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.sneak00000000000 sneak] you may target up to three creatures simultaneously, resolving a separate @Rule[skill.stealth] check against the passive @Rule[skill.awareness] of each.

Playtest Notes

All three checks resolve, but Crucible does not yet record which creatures have lost track of you, so beating one target conceals you no differently from beating all three and the Gamemaster adjudicates the difference. A forthcoming stealth effect will record detection for each creature and treat this talent as raising how many you may evade at once.

Inflection: Compose.name: Inflection: Compose
Inflection: Compose.description: Enhance a spell by taking extra time in its formation, reducing other resource costs in exchange. The Compose inflection reduces the @Rule[resource.focus] cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its @Rule[resource.action] cost by 1 in exchange.

Inflection: Determine.name: Inflection: Determine
Inflection: Determine.description: Enhance a spell to make it more difficult to counter. Any attempt to @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.counterspell0000 counterspell] this spell is made with @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes}.

Inflection: Elude.name: Inflection: Elude
Inflection: Elude.description: Enhance a spell to make it more difficult for an enemy to retaliate against its casting. This spell does not provide any opportunity to make reactions that involve Strike attacks, regardless of the results of the spell.

Inflection: Extend.name: Inflection: Extend
Inflection: Extend.description:
Enhance the duration of a spell, increasing the duration of its effect. For spells which are instantaneous, any corresponding status conditions that they cause are increased in duration.

Effect duration increases from the Extend inflection are not yet automated in Playtest 1. This inflection is included as an example of the intended direction for the Spellcraft system.

Inflection: Negate.name: Inflection: Negate
Inflection: Negate.description:
Invert the effect of a spell. A @Spell[life.touch] spell which normally heals a target becomes a @Spell[life.touch.negate] spell, dealing Poison damage instead. A @Spell[death.ward] spell which normally increases resistance to Corruption damage becomes a @Spell[death.ward.negate] spell, inflicting vulnerability to Corruption damage upon an enemy instead.

The effects of the Negate inflection are not yet automated for Playtest 1. This inflection is included as an example of the intended direction for the Spellcraft system.

Inflection: Pull.name: Inflection: Pull
Inflection: Pull.description: Empower a spell to attract affected creatures toward the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Pull inflection move are forcibly moved a distance towards the spellcaster equal to the Ability Bonus that applied to the Spell, potentially colliding with walls or other movement-blocking obstacles.

Inflection: Push.name: Inflection: Push
Inflection: Push.description: Empower a spell to repel affected creatures away from the caster. Creatures affected by a spell with the Push inflection are forcibly moved a distance away from the spellcaster equal to the Ability Bonus that applied to the Spell, potentially colliding with walls or other movement-blocking obstacles.

Inflection: Quicken.name: Inflection: Quicken
Inflection: Quicken.description: Enhance a spell by hastening the speed with which it can be cast, at the expense of increased @Rule[resource.focus]. The Quicken inflection reduces the @Rule[resource.action] cost of a spell by 1 while increasing its @Rule[resource.focus] cost by 1 in exchange.

Inflection: React.name: Inflection: React
Inflection: React.description: Instinctually compose a spell as a @Rule[action.reaction] in response to some other action that you observe. The React inflection increases the @Rule[resource.focus] cost of a spell by 2.

Inflection: Reshape.name: Inflection: Reshape
Inflection: Reshape.description:
Enhance a Spell by carefully reshaping and controlling its area of effect at the cost of 2 Focus.

Offensive spells which use a region target only enemies within the area. Healing spells which use a region target only allies within the area.

Single target spells do not incur any @Rule[dice.bane]{Banes} due to intervening creatures.

Inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
Inquisitor.description:
You are an expert in combat against magic users, trained to conserve your energy and strike at the precise moment to thwart an incantation.

The cost of your @Action[default reactiveStrike] is reduced by an additional @Rule[resource.action]{1 Action} but always costs @Rule[resource.focus]{1 Focus}. When you Strike an enemy in reaction to them casting a spell, a successful hit drains @Rule[resource.focus]{1 Focus} from that enemy and refunds your own; on a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} their spell is interrupted and the magic is lost.

Abjure.name: Abjure
Abjure.description: You exert your trained will against hostile sorcery, unraveling its hold over you and your nearby allies. For yourself and each ally within 12 feet suffering a magical condition inflicted by an enemy, make an @Rule[skill.arcana] check against the lowest Removal DC among their afflicting conditions. Every such condition whose Removal DC your result exceeds is removed.

Inspirator.name: Inspirator
Inspirator.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Soul. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which restore @Rule[resource.morale] cause the @Condition[inspired] condition.

The Inspired effect lasts for 1 Round and deals the ability score your Rune of Soul scales with as additional Restoration to @Rule[resource.morale].

Inspire Heroism.name: Inspire Heroism
Inspire Heroism.description: Your courageous presence inspires your nearby allies to strike with confidence.

Inspire Heroism.name: Inspire Heroism
Inspire Heroism.description: Each ally, excluding yourself, within 10 feet gains @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} to actions performed until the end of their next turn.

Intellectual Superiority.name: Intellectual Superiority
Intellectual Superiority.description: It is sometimes a marvel how slowly others around you think. You gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} on any Strike or Spell attack against an enemy lower than you in Initiative order.

Intercept.name: Intercept
Intercept.description: You protect your allies, intercepting blows that might otherwise be directed towards your companions.

Intercept.name: Intercept
