Intercept.condition: An enemy moves into or through your Engagement radius.
Intercept.description:
You intercept the path of an enemy which enters your @Rule[movement.engagement] radius, immediately moving up to your @Rule[movement.stride] to interpose yourself and block their path.

If the enemy moves out of your @Rule[movement.engagement] radius or attacks any other creature during their turn, you may make a @Action[default reactiveStrike] against them.

Playtest Notes

The interruption of enemy movement is not yet automated.

Interpose.name: Interpose
Interpose.description: You are willing to throw yourself into harm's way to protect your allies, subjecting yourself to danger in their stead.

Interpose.name: Interpose
Interpose.description:
As a @Rule[action.reaction] when an adjacent ally is hit or glanced by a single-target attack that targeted their Physical Defense, you may Interpose to become the target of that attack instead.

The attack is negated and re-evaluated against your own @Rule[defense.physical]{Physical Defense} using the same dice rolls from the original attack. The consequences of the attack are resolved according to this new result with you as its target.

Interrupting Throw.name: Interrupting Throw
Interrupting Throw.description: You are alert and prepared to use your equipped weapon to interrupt enemy spellcraft.

Interrupting Throw.name: Interrupting Throw
Interrupting Throw.condition: An enemy you can see casts a Spell which costs 3 Action or greater.
Interrupting Throw.description: When an enemy that you can see casts a Spell which costs 3 Action or greater, as a @Rule[action.reaction] you can perform a Thrown weapon attack against the caster. If your attack results in a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} the spell is interrupted and its magic is lost.

Intimidator.name: Intimidator
Intimidator.description: You specialize in exerting your intimidating presence to break the morale of your foes.

Intimidate.name: Intimidate
Intimidate.description: You bring your intimidating presence to bear upon an enemy within 30 feet, performing an @Rule[skill.intimidation] @Rule[action.skill] attack against your target's passive @Rule[skill.intimidation] defense. On a success, they sustain @Rule[action.void] damage to their @Rule[resource.morale].

Intuit Weakness.name: Intuit Weakness
Intuit Weakness.description:
You calm your mind and study the physiology of your foe, seeking a vulnerability in its defenses.

Perform a Knowledge Test using the appropriate Skill for the creature. On a success, you learn the Damage type that the creature has the greatest Vulnerability towards, if any. On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] you learn the two Damage types which have the largest vulnerability.

Intuit Weakness.name: Intuit Weakness
Intuit Weakness.description: You still your mind and study the physiology of your foe, attempting to identify a vulnerability in its defenses.

Iramancer.name: Iramancer
Iramancer.description: Your feats of arcana are fueled by anger. While @Condition[enraged] you may still spend @Rule[resource.focus] and you deal 2 additional damage to all Spell attacks.

Iron Resolve.name: Iron Resolve
Iron Resolve.description: Your physical resilience makes you too tough to be deeply affected by a powerful blow. The @Rule[dice.criticalSuccessThreshold] for Strikes against you is increased by +1, making you harder to critically hit.

Irrepressible Spirit.name: Irrepressible Spirit
Irrepressible Spirit.description: Your tenacity gives you an irrepressible spirit which resists the onset of despair. At the start of your turn if you are not @Condition[broken] you gain @Rule[resource.morale]{1 Morale}.

Jeweler's Mending.name: Jeweler's Mending
Jeweler's Mending.description:
A loosened setting, a cracked band, a stone parted from its claw. You have put back together finer work than most people will ever hold.

The repairs you make using the @Rule[skill.jewelcraft] trade benefit from Expert Repair:

  • You may attempt such repairs without a workbench, though attempts made without one are @Rule[action.difficult].

  • A repair you succeed at never costs the item a Quality tier.

Playtest Notes

Repair is not yet automated. The rules it follows are described in the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.repair0000000000]{Repair} journal.

Juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
Juggernaut.description: You thrive on physical contest, using your extraordinary brawn and grit to overpower creatures whose bulk outstrips even your own. When you @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.grapple000000000 grapple] a creature, you are not @Condition[restrained] yourself. The @Rule[movement.size] of creature that you can Grapple and be Grappled by increases by +1.

Throw.name: Throw
Throw.description:
You heave the target of your @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.grapple000000000 grapple] through the air towards a target point up to a distance of two times your @Rule[ability.strength] score.

You make an @Rule[skill.athletics] skill attack against the @Rule[defense.reflex] defense of your grappled target. On a success the target is thrown, leaving it @Condition[prone]. If its movement is stopped short by a wall or another creature, it slams into the obstacle and suffers Bludgeoning damage from the attack. A creature hurled into open space takes no damage from the throw itself, although it may @Action[default fall].

Regardless of the outcome, your Grapple is released as part of this action.

Overrun.name: Overrun
Overrun.description:
You lower your shoulder and charge in a straight line, bowling over those who stand in your way.

Move up to twice your @Rule[movement.stride] in a straight line, passing through the space of any creature that you could @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.grapple000000000 grapple]. You make an @Rule[skill.athletics] skill attack against the @Rule[defense.reflex] defense of each target, on a success dealing Bludgeoning damage and knocking the creature @Condition[prone].

Your charge is halted by any creature too massive for you to Grapple, which is unaffected by the attack.

Justiciar.name: Justiciar
Justiciar.description: You are an instrument of justice. @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Strike} attacks also deal the Overflow portion of damage to enemy @Rule[resource.morale].

Kineturge.name: Kineturge
Kineturge.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Kinesis. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[bleeding] condition.

The Bleeding effect lasts for 1 Round and deals the ability score your Rune of Kinesis scales with as additional Piercing damage to @Rule[resource.health].

Last Stand.name: Last Stand
Last Stand.description: You can muster the toughness and courage to fight on and stand your ground against improbable odds.

Last Stand.name: Last Stand
Last Stand.description: You expend @Rule[resource.heroism] to instantly recover two times your @Rule[ability.toughness] in @Rule[resource.health]. Your @Rule[defense.wounds] is reduced by 2 for the next 3 Rounds.

Leg Sweep.name: Leg Sweep
Leg Sweep.description: You use a weapon which scales using @Rule[ability.strength] to sweep your enemy off balance, swinging low to knock them from their feet.

Leg Sweep.name: Leg Sweep
Leg Sweep.description: You make a Strike attack with your mainhand weapon. This technique is @Rule[action.difficult] to execute and deals reduced damage, but if successful renders your target @Condition[prone].

Legerdemain.name: Legerdemain
Legerdemain.description: You can silently alter your spellcraft. You may apply any Inflection granted by a talent of Tier 2 or lower using only your hands, without vocalization. A spell you inflect in this way is @Rule[action.subtle] and may be cast even while you are @Condition[silenced].

Lesser Regeneration.name: Lesser Regeneration
Lesser Regeneration.description: Your prodigious hardiness conveys a supernatural capability to recover from wounds quickly. At the start of your turn if you are not @Condition[weakened] you gain @Rule[resource.health]{+1 Health}.

Lightbringer.name: Lightbringer
Lightbringer.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Illumination. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[irradiated] condition.

The Irradiated effect lasts for 1 Round and deals the ability score your Rune of Illumination scales with as Radiant damage to both @Rule[resource.health] and @Rule[resource.morale].

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.description: You know how to wield light weapons fluidly with a high degree of maneuverability and grace in combat.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.description:
You dart forward nimbly, attacking with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a weapon which scales using @Rule[ability.dexterity] against a single target, with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is @Rule[action.difficult], but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke a @Action[default reactiveStrike].

Mark Prey.name: Mark Prey
Mark Prey.description: You fire a special shot which deals no damage, but explodes in luminous powder clearly marking your target.

Mark Prey.name: Mark Prey
Mark Prey.description: You Strike using a special shot. If your attack is successful the target is @Condition[exposed] for the next 3 Rounds.

Martial Artist.name: Martial Artist
Martial Artist.description: You have honed your body into a dangerous weapon. Your bare fists are treated as weapons of Fine quality, increasing their damage by +1.

Mender.name: Mender
Mender.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Life. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which restore @Rule[resource.health] cause the @Condition[mending] condition.

The Mending effect lasts for 1 Round and deals the ability score your Rune of Life scales with as additional Restoration to @Rule[resource.health].

Mental Fortress.name: Mental Fortress
Mental Fortress.description: Your strong will makes you exceedingly difficult to influence. You gain +1 to your @Rule[defense.willpower] defense and +5 Resistance to Psychic damage.

Mesmer.name: Mesmer
Mesmer.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Illusion. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[confused] condition.

The Confused effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half the ability score your Rune of Illusion scales with as Psychic damage to @Rule[resource.morale], and applies the @Condition[disoriented] condition.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description:
Your sharpened mind is full of secrets and techniques to remember them. Once per day you may focus your thoughts and attempt to recall a word that sparks your memory.

The Gamemaster must provide you with a one-word clue that is appropriate for your direction of inquiry. It is left to Gamemaster's discretion how direct or vague to be with the clue they provide.

Mnemonic Realization.name: Mnemonic Realization
Mnemonic Realization.description: You survey your memories attempting to recall a clue for your current situation.

Monk.name: Monk
Monk.description:
You balance monastic discipline with expertise in martial arts, balancing attack and defense in harmony.

While Unarmored, you gain a +2 bonus to your @Rule[defense.reflex] and @Rule[defense.willpower] defenses.

While Unarmed you can use the Double Punch action.

Double Punch.name: Double Punch
Double Punch.description: You Strike twice in the blink of an eye, punching with both arms.

Necromancer.name: Necromancer
Necromancer.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Death. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[decaying] condition.

The Decaying effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals half the ability score your Rune of Death scales with as Corruption damage to @Rule[resource.health] each Round.

Never Yield.name: Never Yield
Never Yield.description: Your determination refuses to let your body's limits slow you down. While @Condition[weakened], your maximum @Rule[resource.action] point penalty is reduced from -2 to -1.

Nosferatu.name: Nosferatu
Nosferatu.description:
You are afflicted with a rare blood mutation which allows your wounds to rapidly heal through hematophagy.

You can restore your @Rule[resource.health] by biting a living target. This attack is made with a Superior Natural weapon which scales using @Rule[ability.strength] and deals Piercing damage.

Your Vulnerability to Radiant damage increases by 10.

Vampiric Bite.name: Vampiric Bite
Vampiric Bite.condition: Your target is a living creature.
Vampiric Bite.description: You grasp an enemy and bite it with sharp incisors, rapidly draining its blood to heal your own wounds. This attack requires a free hand to grasp your target while you feed, and recovers your @Rule[ability.toughness] score in @Rule[resource.health].

Open Vessel.name: Open Vessel
Open Vessel.description:
You have set the first glyph into a hundred mundane things, and you know how readily unspoiled work accepts it.

You gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} when binding an affix to an item which bears no enchantment.

Playtest Notes

The crafting system is in early development. This talent describes how Enchanting will behave once glyph binding is implemented.

Operator.name: Operator
Operator.description:
You have ice in your veins and remain cool under pressure. Your physical toughness and mental acuity allow you to hone the danger of your situation to achieve the greatest results when the stakes are highest.

While in combat and not @Condition[incapacitated], you gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} to all checks when you have less than 50% of your maximum @Rule[resource.health] remaining. You gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to all checks when you have less than 25% of your maximum @Rule[resource.health] remaining.

Cold Focus.name: Cold Focus
Cold Focus.description: You expend @Rule[resource.heroism], drawing icy clarity from your circumstances to restore @Rule[resource.focus]{1 Focus}, plus 1 additional @Rule[resource.focus] for every 25% of your maximum @Rule[resource.health] you are missing, to a maximum of 5.

Opportunist.name: Opportunist
Opportunist.description: You seize any opportunity you can to capitalize on an enemy who turns their back on you. You may make a @Action[default reactiveStrike] even if you are otherwise @Rule[movement.fullyEngaged].

Opportunistic Spellcraft.name: Opportunistic Spellcraft
Opportunistic Spellcraft.description: Your quick thinking can weave magic to exploit brief windows of opportunity. You may make a @Action[default reactiveStrike] using the Touch Gesture instead of a melee weapon attack.

Orbiting Aegis.name: Orbiting Aegis
Orbiting Aegis.description: You can set your implement wheeling about you of its own accord, turning aside blows that would otherwise land.

Orbiting Aegis.name: Orbiting Aegis
Orbiting Aegis.description:
You set your Talisman into a defensive orbit which persists until you dismiss it. While the Aegis turns and you have a Talisman equipped, you gain a bonus to your @Rule[defense.block] defense equal to your current @Rule[resource.focus], to a maximum of +3. Each time the Aegis turns a blow aside you spend @Rule[resource.focus]{1 Focus}.

Dismiss the Aegis by removing its effect.

Overwatch.name: Overwatch
Overwatch.description: You hold the battlefield in your sights, ready to punish any foe who acts within your line of fire. Any enemy who acts against another creature risks your shot, and a spellcaster who weaves magic before you risks the unraveling of their spellcraft as well.

Covering Fire.name: Covering Fire
Covering Fire.condition: An enemy you can see casts a spell, or takes an action that targets a creature other than itself.
Covering Fire.description: As a @Rule[action.reaction] you may make a ranged Strike against that enemy. If the triggering action is a spell, a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} interrupts it and the magic is lost. A self-targeted action that is not a spell, such as @Action[default move] or @Action[default defend], does not trigger this Reaction, which may be used only once per Round.

Patient Deflection.name: Patient Deflection
Patient Deflection.description: Your expertise with martial arts allows you to dodge or deflect blows as effectively as a heavily armored fighter. While Unarmed or wielding only Natural weapons, half your @Rule[ability.wisdom] score contributes to your @Rule[defense.parry] defense.

Patient Soul.name: Patient Soul
Patient Soul.description: Your breadth of experience has taught you that healing wounds to the soul cannot be rushed, but requires methodical effort. Your usage of the Rune of Soul scales with @Rule[ability.wisdom] instead of @Rule[ability.presence].

Peltast.name: Peltast
Peltast.description:
A thrown weapon that departs your hand is guided by an arcane discipline which bends its path to your will, lending your throws a reach and precision that no unaided arm could match. Weapons you throw are returned unerringly back to your grasp. You gain the following benefits:

  • You can use @Action[default throwWeapon] with any melee weapon or shield with full effectiveness, even those not designed to be thrown.

  • A weapon designed for throwing with the Thrown property gains +10 feet of range in your hands, reaching 20 feet.

  • Weapons you throw automatically and immediately return to your hand.

Ricochet.name: Ricochet
Ricochet.description:
Make a Thrown weapon attack at an enemy within range. Guided by your arcane instinct, your weapon ricochets onward to the closest enemy within a maximum distance equal to your @Rule[ability.intellect], so long as no wall blocks its path.

The weapon will continue caroming from foe to foe, hitting each only once, until it has struck a maximum number of enemies equal to half your @Rule[ability.intellect].

Resolve a separate attack against each enemy struck. Each attack after the first suffers a cumulative -1 Damage as the throw sheds momentum.

Penetrating Shot.name: Penetrating Shot
Penetrating Shot.description: You load special ammunition which deals less damage but penetrates directly through a line of targets.

Penetrating Shot.name: Penetrating Shot
Penetrating Shot.description: You fire a shot which penetrates through multiple targets in a direct line.

Penetrating Throw.name: Penetrating Throw
Penetrating Throw.description: You can hurl a weapon which scales using @Rule[ability.strength] with such ferocity that it strikes all targets in a direct line.

Penetrating Throw.name: Penetrating Throw
Penetrating Throw.description: You perform a Thrown weapon strike which penetrates to hit all enemies in a straight line.

Perspicacity.name: Perspicacity
Perspicacity.description: You take in your surroundings without needing to stop and look. You may sacrifice your @Rule[movement.freeMovement] for the Round to instead @Action[default search] without spending any @Rule[resource.action] points.

Piercing Bolts.name: Piercing Bolts
Piercing Bolts.description: You have learned to shape your bolts to a needle point which slips between wards and scales alike. Your Talisman attacks ignore 2 points of the target's Resistance.

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.description: You fire a tactically placed shot to pin your target against a nearby surface.

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.description: You Strike from distance. The attack is @Rule[action.difficult], however if your target is hit they become @Condition[restrained] until the end of their next Turn.

Pistoleer.name: Pistoleer
Pistoleer.description: Your familiarity with mechanical firearms is unmatched. You can perform the @Action[default reload] action for free once per round.

Salvo.name: Salvo
Salvo.description: You fire a barrage of attacks using a one-handed mechanical weapon, shooting three times at a target without the need to reload in-between shots.

Planned Defense.name: Planned Defense
Planned Defense.description: You exert strong battlefield judgment to prepare your defenses against the attacks of your foes. Any enemy which acts after you in Initiative order suffers @Rule[dice.bane]{+1 Bane} to their spell or weapon attacks against you.

Poisoner.name: Poisoner
Poisoner.description: You can apply Poison to weapons which deal Slashing or Piercing damage. You deal an additional +2 damage whenever you deal Poison damage and your Strikes cause the @Condition[poisoned] condition on @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage to @Rule[resource.health].

Poison Blades.name: Poison Blades
Poison Blades.description: You nimbly lather your blades in toxic alchemical oils which apply the @Condition[poisoned] condition on @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits}.

Powerful Physique.name: Powerful Physique
Powerful Physique.description: You can wield weapons with the Slow trait and wear @Rule[defense.armor] with the Bulky trait without suffering @Rule[dice.bane]{Banes} to your Initiative rolls.

Powerful Throw.name: Powerful Throw
Powerful Throw.description: The maximum range of actions with the @Rule[action.thrown] tag or actions from Bomb consumables are doubled

Precision Shot.name: Precision Shot
Precision Shot.description: You take time to steady your aim and target the weakest point of a foe. You may only get one shot, but you make it count.

Precision Shot.name: Precision Shot
Precision Shot.description: You steady your aim and fire a single @Rule[action.accurate] shot.

Preparedness.name: Preparedness
Preparedness.description: You seem to always be prepared for the moment at hand. You may sacrifice your @Rule[movement.freeMovement] for the round to instead equip an Item from your inventory without spending any @Rule[resource.action] points.

Preternatural Instinct.name: Preternatural Instinct
Preternatural Instinct.description: Your quickness of mind and body are equally impressive. You gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to all Initiative checks.

Primalist.name: Primalist
Primalist.description:
The potency of Elemental Runes flows through you. By adopting an elemental Stance you channel a Rune through your weapon Strikes. You may enter a Stance for one of the Elemental Runes that you know:

  • @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeEarth0000000]{Rune: Earth}

  • @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeFlame0000000]{Rune: Flame}

  • @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeFrost0000000]{Rune: Frost}

  • @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeStorm0000000]{Rune: Storm}

You may enter or change your Stance once per Turn, and your entered stance lasts until you change it or until Combat ends. While in a Stance, talents or features which apply @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit} effects for actions that use that Stance's Rune apply to your weapon Strikes as well.

Storm Stance.name: Storm Stance
Storm Stance.condition: You know the Rune of Storm.
Storm Stance.description: You adopt the Storm Stance, channeling the Rune of Storm. While in this Stance your @Rule[movement.stride] is increased by 2.

Cinder Stance.name: Cinder Stance
Cinder Stance.condition: You know the Rune of Flame.
Cinder Stance.description: You adopt the Cinder Stance, channeling the Rune of Flame. While in this Stance your weapon Strikes deal 2 additional Fire damage.

Water Stance.name: Water Stance
Water Stance.condition: You know the Rune of Frost.
Water Stance.description: You adopt the Water Stance, channeling the Rune of Frost. While in this Stance you gain +1 to your @Rule[defense.reflex], @Rule[defense.fortitude], and @Rule[defense.willpower] defenses.

Stone Stance.name: Stone Stance
Stone Stance.condition: You know the Rune of Earth.
Stone Stance.description: You adopt the Stone Stance, channeling the Rune of Earth. While in this Stance you gain +2 Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

Provocateur.name: Provocateur
Provocateur.description: You specialize in barbed repartee crafted to highlight your opponent's shortcomings. In combat you can launch quips which provoke your foes.

Scathing Mockery.name: Scathing Mockery
Scathing Mockery.condition: Your target can hear and understand you.
Scathing Mockery.description:
You exaggerate your opponent's shortcomings with a scathing bon mot, improvising a @Rule[skill.performance] skill attack against your target's @Rule[defense.willpower]. On a @Rule[dice.success] they suffer modest Psychic damage to @Rule[resource.morale].

On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess], they also become @Condition[enraged] for 1 Round.

Pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
Pyromancer.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Flame. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[burning] condition.

The Burning effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals half the ability score your Rune of Flame scales with as Fire damage to both @Rule[resource.health] and @Rule[resource.morale].

Quick Draw.name: Quick Draw
Quick Draw.description: You have a basic education in archery and other projectile weaponry.

Quick Draw.name: Quick Draw
Quick Draw.description: You can loose a shot under pressure, although with decreased accuracy. You perform a Strike that is @Rule[action.difficult], but has a reduced @Rule[resource.action] cost.

Quickening.name: Quickening
Quickening.description: Years of binding have taught your hands to feel magic through leather and steel. Whether a glyph was freshly set or has long since sunk into the grain, you know that it is there.

Quickening.name: Quickening
Quickening.condition: You have an Enchanter's Toolkit equipped.
Quickening.description:
With an Enchanter's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You need only touch an item to know whether it is enchanted, whether or not it belongs to you. Handling it at length tells you which affixes it bears and how much of its capacity remains unspent.

  • Destroy. You touch an object bearing a minor enchantment which still waits upon its condition, whether your own work or another enchanter's, and unmake it. The object itself is unharmed. Alternatively you may conceal an item's enchantment for 10 minutes, so that it reads as mundane to anyone whose passive @Rule[skill.enchanting] does not exceed your own, though it loses nothing of its power.

  • Create. You imbue a Rune you know into an object no larger than a foot in any dimension, empowering it to perform one simple task under a condition you name. The enchantment lasts until the object has performed that task once, or until 24 hours have passed.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry
Rallying Cry.description: Your presence as a battlefield leader hardens the resolve of your allies, enabling them to sustain their morale in even the most harrowing of circumstances.

Rallying Cry.name: Rallying Cry
Rallying Cry.description: You produce a courageous bellow that inspires allies within 12 feet of you to remain stalwart in the face of peril. You make an @Rule[skill.intimidation] check against the @Rule[defense.madness] of each ally. Upon a success, they become @Condition[resolute] for 3 Rounds. Upon a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess], they also recover an amount of @Rule[resource.morale] equal to your @Rule[ability.presence] score.

Rapid Countermeasure.name: Rapid Countermeasure
Rapid Countermeasure.description: Fire, frost, acid and the arc each obey rules, and those rules say what answers them. Any student of the sciences can recite the list. Fewer can find the right vial by touch while a companion is still burning.

Rapid Countermeasure.name: Rapid Countermeasure
Rapid Countermeasure.condition: You must have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped in your Toolbelt.
Rapid Countermeasure.description:
You smother, douse, neutralize, or earth an elemental reaction afflicting an ally you can touch. Remove one instance of @Condition[burning], @Condition[freezing], @Condition[corroding], or @Condition[shocked] from the target.

The reagents are drawn from your Toolkit and are not otherwise tracked.

Rapid Reload.name: Rapid Reload
Rapid Reload.description: You are familiar in the design and usage of crossbows, firearms, and other similar armaments.

Rapid Reload.name: Rapid Reload
Rapid Reload.description: You focus deeply and calm your nerves to quickly Reload your mechanical weapon with exceptional haste.

Recognize Spellcraft.name: Recognize Spellcraft
Recognize Spellcraft.description: You can interpret the arcane incantations of others to discern the nature of their spellcraft. When an enemy within 40 feet that you can see and hear begins casting a spell, you can identify its Rune if you also know that Rune.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft.

Refocus.name: Refocus
Refocus.description:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some @Rule[resource.focus]. You perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Strike against your own @Rule[defense.madness].

On a success you recover @Rule[resource.focus]{+1 Focus} if using a one-handed Talisman and @Rule[resource.focus]{+2 Focus} if using a two-handed Talisman. On a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] the amount of @Rule[resource.focus] recovered increases by an additional +1.

Repercussive Block.name: Repercussive Block
Repercussive Block.description: You can channel explosive force into a counter-bash which can disarm your opponent when blocking with your shield.

Repercussive Block.name: Repercussive Block
Repercussive Block.condition: You Block a Melee attack with an equipped shield.
Repercussive Block.description: When you @Rule[defense.block] a Melee attack, you can react to counter-attack with your equipped shield. This technique is @Rule[action.harmless] but, if successful, will disarm your opponent forcing their weapon to be Dropped.

Resilient.name: Resilient
Resilient.description:
Your body responds eagerly to healing, demonstrating a remarkable ability to recover from wounds.

Your @Rule[defense.wounds] is reduced by 1, making you easier to heal.

Rimecaller.name: Rimecaller
Rimecaller.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Frost. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[freezing] condition.

The Freezing effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half the ability score your Rune of Frost scales with as Frost damage to @Rule[resource.health], and applies the @Condition[slowed] condition.

Rout.name: Rout
Rout.description: You understand that panic can be contagious, you just have to cause it. When you cause a foe to become @Condition[broken] or @Condition[insane], every enemy within 10 feet who can see that creature suffers damage to their @Rule[resource.morale] equal to your @Rule[ability.presence].

Rune: Control.name: Rune: Control
Rune: Control.description:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using @Rule[ability.wisdom], targets @Rule[defense.willpower], and deals Psychic damage to @Rule[resource.morale]. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.

Motivate.name: Motivate
Motivate.description:
Your command of the Rune of Control allows you to affect the decision making of others in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Moderately intensify or dampen the primary emotion being felt by a creature you touch. If the creature is intelligent enough to be aware of the laws governing spellcraft, they are aware of your actions.

  • Understand the abstract motivations of another living creature which allows you to touch it. You are able to intuit their immediate goals expressed in the form of a single verb.

  • Intensely focus on your current objective and the means of achieving it. You receive a brief hint or reminder from the Gamemaster about that objective containing only information which you have previously learned.

Motivate may only affect a creature or object which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Death.name: Rune: Death
Rune: Death.description:
The orderly force of destruction, responsible for the corruption of all biological matter. The Death rune governs decay and destruction.

The Death rune scales using @Rule[ability.presence], targets @Rule[defense.fortitude], and deals Corruption damage to @Rule[resource.health]. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Life.

Ennervate.name: Ennervate
Ennervate.description:
Your command of the Rune of Death allows for basic communion with the dead and for rudimentary manipulation of unholy forces, producing one of the following effects:

  • Spread decay over an object no larger than a 1-foot cube, causing plants to wither, metallic objects to rust, wood to become rotten, food to grow foul, or a corpse to rapidly decompose. Magical objects are typically unaffected.

  • Cause a corpse which has been dead for less than seven days or otherwise preserved to perform a lifeless reenactment of its final moments. Its movements imitate those that occurred during the creature's final 30 seconds of life. You have no control over the creature nor can it communicate in any other way.

  • Hasten the death of a willing creature that is currently dying, causing it to pass swiftly and peacefully.

Ennervate may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Earth.name: Rune: Earth
Rune: Earth.description:
The orderly force of elemental earth, responsible for physical matter. The Earth rune governs minerals, metals, soils, and other physical compounds.

The Earth rune scales using @Rule[ability.wisdom], targets @Rule[defense.reflex], and deals Acid damage to @Rule[resource.health]. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Storm.

Mould.name: Mould
Mould.description:
Your command of the Rune of Earth allows you to manipulate raw forces of rock, mineral, and soil in basic ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Quickly shape up to one cubic foot of available material into a simple geometric form like a cuboid, ellipsoid, or polyhedron.

  • Precisely copy the physical shape of a held object that is smaller than a 6-inch cube, reproducing it from available clay, stone, or metal. The replica retains no useful properties except for its physical form.

  • Separate and collect earthen particles from the surface of an object, creature, or liquid that you touch, rendering the subject completely cleaned or purified in moments.

Mould may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Flame.name: Rune: Flame
Rune: Flame.description:
The chaotic force of elemental, thermal energy. The Flame rune governs fire and heat.

The Flame rune scales using @Rule[ability.intellect], targets @Rule[defense.reflex], and deals Fire damage to @Rule[resource.health]. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Frost.

Enkindle.name: Enkindle
Enkindle.description:
Your command of the Rune of Flame allows you to manipulate fire and thermal energy in creative ways, producing one of the following effects:

  • Manifest a burst of elemental flame in one inch sphere which can ignite a candle, torch, or other flammable materials.

  • Imbue your body with momentary thermal shielding which provides you with immunity to fire damage on an immediately subsequent action that costs 1 Action or less.

  • Control the movement of flames within a small area, causing them to flicker, dance, or shift in an animated performance of light and shadow.

Enkindle may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Frost.name: Rune: Frost
Rune: Frost.description:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using @Rule[ability.wisdom], targets @Rule[defense.fortitude], and deals Cold damage to @Rule[resource.health]. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.

Condense.name: Condense
Condense.description:
Your command of the Rune of Frost allows you to manipulate liquids and their thermal properties, producing one of the following effects:

  • Draw up to one quarter gallon of fresh water from the atmosphere into a container or upon a surface you touch. The created water may be affected by relevant atmospheric properties of your current location.

  • Manipulate the temperature of up to 1 gallon of water, causing it to immediately freeze or thaw. The water need not be in a container; this technique can be used to coat a surface or join two objects together via regelation. Ice created in this way remains frozen for as long as the ambient temperature of the environment allows.

  • Gather up to a six-foot cube of nearby snow, forming it into a solidified sculpture, shape, or shelter.

Condense may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Illumination.name: Rune: Illumination
Rune: Illumination.description:
The orderly force of light and energy. The Illumination rune governs light and radiance.

The Illumination rune scales using @Rule[ability.presence], targets @Rule[defense.reflex], and deals Radiant damage to @Rule[resource.health]. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Illusion.

Reveal.name: Reveal
Reveal.description:
Your command of the Rune of Illumination allows you to create light and exert basic control over its radiance, producing one of the following effects:

  • Create a ball of light called a "tosslight" which sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius and dim light in a 40 foot radius. The light can hover near your body, be affixed to an item or surface, or be thrown up to a distance of 30 feet. You may dismiss your tosslight at any time and may only have a single tosslight at a time, casting this spell again causes your previous tosslight to disappear.

  • Inscribe up to 200 words of invisible text into paper like a scroll, page, or book. The text is written from light itself and hidden from non-magical detection. It can be made visible by yourself or another through use of this spell combined with a spoken passphrase that you define at the time of inscription.

  • Touch a physical object that produces dim light, causing it to become bright light for as long as you maintain physical contact. Only one light source may be intensified in this way at a given time.

Reveal may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Illusion.name: Rune: Illusion
Rune: Illusion.description:
The chaotic force of trickery and whimsy. The Illusion rune governs magical manifestations of falsehood or misdirection.

The Illusion rune scales using @Rule[ability.intellect], targets @Rule[defense.willpower] defense, and deals Psychic damage to @Rule[resource.morale]. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Illumination.

Seeming.name: Seeming
Seeming.description:
Your command of the Rune of Illusion allows you to fabricate perception in various simple ways and to manipulate shadow and light to create distraction or entertainment, producing one of the following effects:

  • Modify a single aspect of your own physical appearance. Such alterations might include adjusting the sound of your voice, changing the color of your eyes, gaining illusory horns, or appearing slightly taller or shorter. The alteration persists until you Rest or enact a different alteration and can be verified as illusory by physical inspection.

  • Manifest a convincing recreation of a short sound or single scent that you can clearly recall. The illusion originates from your position and lasts for 10 seconds. You can control the volume of the sound or odorousness of the scent to be perceptible up to a range of 60 feet or shorter.

  • Decouple your shadow from your form, specifically controlling its movements separately from your own. You can maintain this illusion as long as you do not perform any other action that consumes @Rule[resource.focus].

Seeming may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Kinesis.name: Rune: Kinesis
Rune: Kinesis.description:
The chaotic force of space and physical movement. The Kinesis rune governs all things related to the act of movement and physicality.

The Kinesis rune scales using @Rule[ability.presence], targets @Rule[defense.physical] defense, and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage to @Rule[resource.health]. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Control.

Propel.name: Propel
Propel.description:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your @Rule[ability.presence], altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Life.name: Rune: Life
Rune: Life.description:
A chaotic force of creation, responsible for living matter. The Life rune governs health and matters relating to biological growth.

The Life rune scales using @Rule[ability.wisdom] and provides Restoration of @Rule[resource.health]. In special circumstances it may be used to inflict Poison damage opposed by @Rule[defense.fortitude]. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Death.

Bloom.name: Bloom
Bloom.description:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Oblivion.name: Rune: Oblivion
Rune: Oblivion.description:
A chaotic force of destruction and annihilation of existence. The Oblivion rune governs unmaking of matter or decoherence of spirit.

The Oblivion rune scales using @Rule[ability.intellect], targets @Rule[defense.willpower], and deals Void damage to @Rule[resource.morale]. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Soul.

Erase.name: Erase
Erase.description:
Your command of the Rune of Oblivion allows you to unravel tiny holes in the fabric of existence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Disintegrate a non-magical object you hold smaller than a 6-inch cube, sundering it to a fine particulate dust of its component elements.

  • Anesthetize the ability to feel emotion from yourself or a willing target that you touch, causing it to enter a placid, stoic, or dispassionate state. This effect can be maintained as long as you make no further Action.

  • Subdue the potency of a light source, causing its visible radius to be reduced by half for as long as you maintain physical contact with it. Only one light source may be dampened in this way at a given time.

Erase may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Soul.name: Rune: Soul
Rune: Soul.description:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using @Rule[ability.presence] and provides Restoration of @Rule[resource.morale]. In special circumstances it may be used to inflict Psychic damage opposed by @Rule[defense.willpower]. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.

Evoke.name: Evoke
Evoke.description:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Rune: Storm.name: Rune: Storm
Rune: Storm.description:
The chaotic force of raw electrical energy. The Storm rune governs sources of electrical charge and discharge.

The Storm rune scales using @Rule[ability.intellect], targets @Rule[defense.reflex], and deals Electricity damage to @Rule[resource.health]. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Earth.

Energize.name: Energize
Energize.description:
Your command of the Rune of Storm allows you to conduct the flow of both air and electricity, manipulating charge and aerodynamics to produce one of the following effects:

  • Instill an electromagnetic charge into a metallic object that you touch no larger than a one-foot cube, causing it to strongly adhere to other metals. Only one object can be charged in this way at a given time, casting this spell on a different object causes the prior object to lose its magnetic effect.

  • Gather a squall of wind at your current location in a six-foot radius which blows either as a gust in a single controlled direction or as a cyclone with centripetal force in all directions. Airborne effects in the immediate area are dispersed and unsecured objects with weight less than 1 are flung in the direction of the gust.

  • Produce the concussive sound of a thunderclap at a location you can see within 15 feet of your current position.

Energize may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Runewarden.name: Runewarden
Runewarden.description:
Your mastery of the arcane makes you more resilient to elemental and spiritual harm. You gain a bonus to Resistance equal to half your @Rule[ability.wisdom] for each Elemental or Spiritual damage type where you know the Arcane Rune attuned to that damage type.

When you use the Ward gesture, the Resistance provided by your Ward also increases by half your @Rule[ability.wisdom].

Ruthless Momentum.name: Ruthless Momentum
Ruthless Momentum.description: You relish the carnage you can cause in combat and continue to press the fray as each enemy falls.

Ruthless Momentum.name: Ruthless Momentum
Ruthless Momentum.condition: You incapacitate an enemy with a melee attack.
Ruthless Momentum.description: After defeating an enemy, you immediately move up to your @Rule[movement.stride] and Strike another foe that you pass next to or end your movement adjacent to.

Saboteur.name: Saboteur
Saboteur.description: You are skilled with the use of thrown munitions. When using a consumable of the Bomb type you always count as at least Trained regardless of which skill is used and you gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} to any involved check.

Safecracker.name: Safecracker
Safecracker.description: You are skilled in the arts of disarming traps and picking locks. You gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} on @Rule[skill.stealth] checks to disable a device or open a lock.

Sage.name: Sage
Sage.description: Your encyclopedic learning spans every field of study. Through disciplined research and sudden flashes of insight you can call upon Knowledge to aid you during key moments.

Flash of Brilliance.name: Flash of Brilliance
Flash of Brilliance.description: You expend @Rule[resource.heroism] and experience a sudden, brilliant moment of total clarity. Until the end of your next turn you are treated as possessing every form of Knowledge.

Field Study.name: Field Study
Field Study.description: During the process of a @Action[default rest], you devote yourself to studying a chosen field of Knowledge. Upon the completion of the Rest, you gain that Knowledge for the next 24 hours or until you use this action again.

Seasoned Veteran.name: Seasoned Veteran
Seasoned Veteran.description: You battlefield experience makes you accustomed to engaging multiple foes. Your @Rule[movement.engagement] increases by +1, allowing you to simultaneously engage more adjacent foes.

Second Skin.name: Second Skin
Second Skin.description:
You have worn harness long enough that it no longer feels like a piece of equipment to lug around. The straps sit where they should, the load rides on your frame, and you stopped noticing the weight of your armor years ago.

Your equipped Armor counts only half its weight towards the load you can carry.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description: Your physical hardiness allows you to push yourself beyond conventional limits.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description: You focus your energy and recover your @Rule[ability.toughness] score in @Rule[resource.health].

Sentinel.name: Sentinel
Sentinel.description: You punish those who try to slip past your guard. When you damage an enemy with a @Action[default reactiveStrike], that creature becomes @Condition[slowed] until the end of its next turn.

Sentinel Bolts.name: Sentinel Bolts
Sentinel Bolts.description: You set a ring of waiting motes wheeling slowly about you. They keep their own watch, and they strike without being told.

Sentinel Bolts.name: Sentinel Bolts
Sentinel Bolts.description:
You surround yourself with an aura of attendant motes which is @Rule[action.maintained] at a cost of @Rule[resource.focus]{1 Focus} per turn. Any enemy which enters the aura or ends its turn within it suffers a Talisman attack.

Playtest Notes

The aura is placed and maintained, but its attacks against enemies who enter or end their turn within it are not yet automated.

Shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
Shapeshifter.description:
You possess supernatural ability to transform your body into the shapes of beasts.

You undergo a transformation where you assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with and which is half your level or less. While transformed you have the exact attributes and abilities of the chosen beast.

Your equipment is magically incorporated into the form that you take, however you gain no benefit from that equipment while transformed.

If your bestial form becomes @Condition[incapacitated] you revert back to your normal form with any excess damage becoming @Rule[resource.wounds]. If your @Rule[resource.morale] is @Condition[broken] while in beast form your transformation ends and any excess damage becomes @Rule[resource.madness].

Playtest Notes

This talent and its associated actions are not yet automated.

Beast Shape.name: Beast Shape
Beast Shape.description: You assume the form of a beast that you are familiar with of one-half your level or less.

Revert Shape.name: Revert Shape
Revert Shape.description: You end your bestial transformation, returning to your normal form.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: You are practiced at fighting with shield, using it to slam into and unbalance your foes.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: Following a basic @Action[default strike] with your mainhand weapon, you Strike with your shield, causing the @Condition[staggered] condition for 1 Round.

Shield Charge.name: Shield Charge
Shield Charge.description: A defensive technique in which you drive forward, slamming and pushing foes out of your path. You charge up to 20 feet in a straight line and perform an offhand shield Strike against each successive foe along your path.

Shield Charge.name: Shield Charge
Shield Charge.description: You charge forward in a straight line, passing through the space of any creatures you encounter and making a Strike against each successive foe. Any creature @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critically Hit} by the attack may be pushed into an adjacent space of your choosing. You may not end your charge in the same space as another creature.

Shield Ward.name: Shield Ward
Shield Ward.description: You have mastered a specialized technique to incorporate a physical shield into the Ward gesture. You may ignore the free-hand requirement for spells using the Ward gesture while you have a Shield equipped.

Skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
Skirmisher.description: You are adept at entering and exiting the fray. When moving out of the @Rule[movement.engagement] radius of an enemy, that enemy has @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes} to any @Action[default reactiveStrike] against you.

Slipstep.name: Slipstep
Slipstep.description: Your nimbleness allows you to occasionally perform exceptionally elusive maneuvers to evade harm on the battlefield.

Slipstep.name: Slipstep
Slipstep.description:
As a @Rule[action.reaction] to an action that targets you before it is confirmed, you may expend @Rule[resource.heroism] to instantly move up to your @Rule[movement.stride]. The interrupted action is nullified without being confirmed or applying any effects.

This movement does not provoke any @Action[default reactiveStrike].

Slow Simmer.name: Slow Simmer
Slow Simmer.description:
You keep the fire and the pot, and you have the ingenuity to cook meals in circumstances that are far from ideal.

A meal you prepare lasts 16 hours rather than 8. Those who eat it recover an additional amount of @Rule[resource.wounds] and @Rule[resource.madness] equal to half your @Rule[ability.wisdom] when the @Action[default rest] concludes. You may prepare a meal wherever the party is able to Rest at all, without fire or shelter.

Playtest Notes

Meals are not yet implemented. This talent describes how the @Rule[skill.cooking] trade will behave once meal preparation is a Rest activity.

Smith's Mending.name: Smith's Mending
Smith's Mending.description:
You have mended enough ruined steel to know that a break is only the metal telling you how it was made. Given a hammer and an hour, you can persuade it back.

The repairs you make using the @Rule[skill.smithing] trade benefit from Expert Repair:

  • You may attempt such repairs without a workbench, though attempts made without one are @Rule[action.difficult].

  • A repair you succeed at never costs the item a Quality tier.

Playtest Notes

Repair is not yet automated. The rules it follows are described in the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.repair0000000000]{Repair} journal.

Snakeblood.name: Snakeblood
Snakeblood.description: Your supernatural toughness makes you resistant to venoms and toxins. You gain +5 Resistance to Poison damage.

Sneak.name: Sneak
Sneak.description:
You move quietly and cautiously to break one opponent's awareness of your position, slipping out of their notice while they remain occupied elsewhere.

Playtest Notes

The Stealth check resolves and marks you concealed for its duration. Crucible does not yet record which creatures have lost track of you, so the Gamemaster adjudicates that: your target is treated as @Condition[unaware] of you for actions which check that condition, though the status itself is not applied and token visibility does not change. A forthcoming stealth effect will record detection for each creature individually.

Sneak.name: Sneak
Sneak.description: Target one enemy which you can see at a distance of at least 20 feet. You make a @Rule[skill.stealth] check against their passive @Rule[skill.awareness]. Upon a success that creature loses track of you until the start of your next turn, or until you perform an action targeting them which is not @Rule[action.subtle]. Upon a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] the effect instead persists for 2 Rounds.

Soothe.name: Soothe
Soothe.description: You administer a soothing performance which rallies your allies, restoring @Rule[resource.morale].

Soothe.name: Soothe
Soothe.description: You perform a calming verse, benefiting all allies who can perceive you within 12 feet. Make a @Rule[skill.performance] check against the @Rule[defense.madness] of each ally. On success, each ally's @Rule[resource.morale] is restored.

Sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
Sorcerer.description:
Your magic is deeply instinctual and your practice of spellcraft defies traditional academic understanding.

You cannot cast Iconic Spells, but when you cast a spell using an Inflection it deals an additional +1 Damage per Iconic Spell Slot that you have.

Spellblade.name: Spellblade
Spellblade.description:
You are an arcane warrior who can weave together Strike and Spell relying on both martial and arcane techniques in battle. The physical strikes of your weaponry partially substitute for the somatic gestures of traditional spellcraft.

While wielding a Melee weapon as your mainhand weapon, spells you cast using Gesture: Strike benefit from your weapon's damage bonus.

Immediately after performing a Strike with a melee weapon, you may cast a spell with its @Rule[resource.action] cost reduced by 1.

Spellcatch.name: Spellcatch
Spellcatch.description: A spell cast towards you is something to grasp rather than avoid. You have learned a technique to catch an incoming spell with your Talisman and extract its essence for your own purposes.

Spellcatch.name: Spellcatch
Spellcatch.description:
When you are targeted by a Spell you may catch it upon your Talisman. The Spell has no effect upon you and you recover @Rule[resource.focus] equal to the @Rule[resource.focus] which was spent to cast it.

Playtest Notes

This action is not yet automated.

Spellmute.name: Spellmute
Spellmute.description:
Currents of magic flow strangely around you, as if unaware of your presence.

You cannot perform any action with the Spell tag. Spells which target you suffer @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes} regardless of whether they impose harmful or beneficial effects.

Spiritbreaker.name: Spiritbreaker
Spiritbreaker.description:
You wage war upon the mind itself, unraveling the resolve of your foes. Your actions which directly attack @Rule[resource.morale] find the cracks in a creature's will more easily, reducing your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccessThreshold] by 2.

When you cause a target to become @Condition[broken], the shock to their psyche leaves the target @Condition[stunned] until the end of its next turn.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: Your patient resolve allows you to endure psychologically grueling ordeals with steadfast determination.

Steadfast Resolve.name: Steadfast Resolve
Steadfast Resolve.description: You harden yourself against demoralization. Your @Rule[resource.morale] is increased by your @Rule[ability.wisdom] score and you temporarily gain the @Condition[resolute] condition.

Still Lake.name: Still Lake
Still Lake.description:
Your life experiences provide serenity that allows you to resist the attempted manipulation of others.

Skill Attacks against you from any of the Social skills are made with @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes}.

Strategic Repositioning.name: Strategic Repositioning
Strategic Repositioning.description:
You are always thinking ahead about where to position yourself should danger loom. Before Turn 1 of a Combat encounter, provided that you are not @Condition[unaware], you may immediately move up to 4 feet in any permitted direction.

If multiple combatants have this feature, repositioning occurs in reverse order of Initiative.

Playtest Notes

This talent is not yet automated.

Strike First.name: Strike First
Strike First.description: Shoot first, ask questions later. You gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+1 Boon} on any Strike or Spell attack against an enemy whose initiative score is lower than your own.

Strong Grip.name: Strong Grip
Strong Grip.description:
Your grasp of your weaponry is firm and unyielding. While wielding a two-handed weapon that scales with @Rule[ability.strength] you may cast spells which require two hands, and attempts to Disarm you are made with @Rule[dice.bane]{+2 Banes}.

Additionally, you may wield a one-handed Heavy weapon in your off-hand.

Stunning Strike.name: Stunning Strike
Stunning Strike.description: A challenging unarmed technique which targets vital pressure points on the bodies of your adversaries. You unleash a debilitating strike which, if successful, leaves your enemy @Condition[stunned].

Stunning Strike.name: Stunning Strike
Stunning Strike.description: You Strike a vital pressure point, inflicting the @Rule[condition.stunned] condition on your enemy for 1 Round if successful.

Subtle Extrication.name: Subtle Extrication
Subtle Extrication.description: You understand how to move away from an opponent without exposing yourself to the worst attacks in return. Any @Action[default reactiveStrike] against you is performed with @Rule[dice.bane]{+1 Bane}.

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike
Sundering Strike.description: You know a martial technique to exploit the weakest points of an enemy's defenses, exposing them to further harm.

Sundering Strike.name: Sundering Strike
Sundering Strike.description: You make a Strike with a @Rule[ability.strength]-scaling weapon which, if successful, applies the @Condition[exposed] condition to your target for 3 Rounds. This attack is @Rule[action.difficult] to perform and deals @Rule[action.weakened] damage.

Surgeweaver.name: Surgeweaver
Surgeweaver.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Storm. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[shocked] condition.

The Shocked effect lasts for 3 Rounds, deals half the ability score your Rune of Storm scales with as Electricity damage to @Rule[resource.morale], and applies the @Condition[staggered] condition.

Swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
Swashbuckler.description: Your bravado inspires your allies and cows your enemies. When you @Rule[defense.dodge] or @Rule[defense.parry] a Strike, the attacker loses @Rule[resource.morale] equal to your @Rule[ability.presence] attribute. When you achieve a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hit}, all allies within 30 feet who can see you gain @Rule[resource.morale] equal to your @Rule[ability.presence] attribute.

Swipe.name: Swipe
Swipe.description: You perform a broad swipe with your weapon, hitting two adjacent targets within your weapon range.

Swipe.name: Swipe
Swipe.description: You perform a Strike against two adjacent enemies, attacking both of them using a single swing of your great weapon.

Tactician.name: Tactician
Tactician.description: You are a cunning battlefield tactician, able to organize and direct your allies to act with increased effectiveness.

Tactical Plan.name: Tactical Plan
Tactical Plan.description: Using 10 words or fewer, describe a course of action to an ally who acts after you in Initiative order. If that ally carries out your described plan later in the same Round, they gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} on any dice rolls associated with that plan. The Gamemaster may arbitrate whether or not the plan was followed.

Tailor's Mending.name: Tailor's Mending
Tailor's Mending.description:
Torn cloth and split leather hold no fear for you. You have turned worse than this back into something a person would wear into a fight.

The repairs you make using the @Rule[skill.tailoring] trade benefit from Expert Repair:

  • You may attempt such repairs without a workbench, though attempts made without one are @Rule[action.difficult].

  • A repair you succeed at never costs the item a Quality tier.

Playtest Notes

Repair is not yet automated. The rules it follows are described in the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.repair0000000000]{Repair} journal.

Telekinetic.name: Telekinetic
Telekinetic.description:
You wield kinetic force with practiced ease, bending the paths of objects and creatures to your will.

  • Once per turn, when you apply @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionpush00]{Inflection: Push} or @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionpull00]{Inflection: Pull} to a Spell, you ignore the inflection's @Rule[resource.focus] cost.

  • You double the distance at which you can Pull, Flick, or Suspend using the @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeKinesis00000 propel] action.

  • You unlock the Telekinetic Flight action, suspending yourself aloft to fly and hover.

Telekinetic Flight.name: Telekinetic Flight
Telekinetic Flight.description: You suspend yourself aloft on currents of kinetic force, gaining the @Condition[flying] condition to fly and hover. You sustain the effect with @Rule[resource.focus] each round; it ends if you become @Condition[incapacitated].

Tenacious Control.name: Tenacious Control
Tenacious Control.description: Your raw physicality provides an anchor from which you gain the leverage to bend the wills of your enemies. Your usage of the Rune of Control scales with @Rule[ability.toughness] instead of @Rule[ability.wisdom].

Testudo.name: Testudo
Testudo.description: You are highly skilled in using shields to adopt a defensive posture. You gain double the benefit of the @Condition[guarded] condition against Weapon Attacks while wielding a shield.

Thick Skin.name: Thick Skin
Thick Skin.description: Your physical toughness makes you more resistant to harm. You gain +2 Resistance to Bludgeoning, Slashing, and Piercing damage.

Thoughtbinder.name: Thoughtbinder
Thoughtbinder.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Control. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[dominated] condition.

The Dominated effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals the ability score your Rune of Control scales with as additional Psychic damage to @Rule[resource.morale].

Thread the Needle.name: Thread the Needle
Thread the Needle.description: You concentrate to fire a shot into the swirl of melee. This attack benefits from Flanking as if it were a melee attack.

Thread the Needle.name: Thread the Needle
Thread the Needle.description: You fire a precise shot into melee combat, targeting an enemy which is engaged by one of your allies.

Tormentor.name: Tormentor
Tormentor.description: A spirit which can be lifted can just as surely be broken. Spells you compose with the Rune of Soul become spells of torment. They deal @Rule[damageType.psychic] damage to @Rule[resource.morale] instead of restoring it, and are resisted by @Rule[defense.willpower].

Tracery.name: Tracery
Tracery.description: Years of quillwork have steadied your hand. Whether you are inscribing a glyph or illuminating a manuscript, your strokes are immaculate and measured.

Tracery.name: Tracery
Tracery.condition: You have a Glyphweaver's Toolkit equipped.
Tracery.description:
With a Glyphweaver's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study a glyph or a spell scroll which you can handle, learning its Quality tier and which affix or spellcraft components it would impart. You may also study a written or painted work, learning whether it has been altered since it was made, unless it was altered by someone whose passive @Rule[skill.glyphweaving] exceeds your own.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously spoil a glyph, a spell scroll, or a written work which you can physically touch, marring it so that it can no longer be read or used. Alternatively, you may alter a document you can handle, changing a single letter within each word and leaving no obvious trace of your work. Your alteration is discovered only by an intentional @Rule[skill.awareness] check which beats your passive @Rule[skill.glyphweaving].

  • Create. Given time and materials, you may produce any written or painted work you can picture which carries no affix: a letter in another's hand down to the tremor in it, a portrait that flatters without lying, a seal across a door which cannot be rejoined once broken, a mark on a trail only your companions will notice, a line of chalk that glows faintly for an hour.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

True Grit.name: True Grit
True Grit.description: Your physical tenacity allows you to remain composed while surrounded by foes. Your @Rule[movement.engagement] increases by +1, allowing you to simultaneously engage more adjacent foes.

Tumble Through.name: Tumble Through
Tumble Through.description: You can use your athleticism in dangerous situations to escape harm or bypass enemy combatants.

Tumble.name: Tumble
Tumble.description:
You tumble nimbly up to twice your @Rule[movement.stride], passing through the space of one other creature along your path without provoking any @Action[default reactiveStrike]. An ally lets you pass freely.

An enemy contests your passage: make an @Rule[skill.athletics] @Rule[action.skill] attack against its @Rule[defense.reflex] defense. On a @Rule[dice.failure] your movement is blocked and you remain in your current position.

Twinned Shot.name: Twinned Shot
Twinned Shot.description: You prepare two shots to fire simultaneously at a single target.

Twinned Shot.name: Twinned Shot
Twinned Shot.description: You concentrate to nock two projectiles at once making two simultaneous Strikes against the same single target.

Unarmed Blocking.name: Unarmed Blocking
Unarmed Blocking.description: Through long practice and toughened resolve you are able to block enemy blows using your bare limbs. While Unarmed or wielding only Natural weapons, half your @Rule[ability.toughness] score contributes to your @Rule[defense.block] defense.

Undaunted.name: Undaunted
Undaunted.description: Despair takes your voice and your courage, but never your command of the arcane. You may continue to spend @Rule[resource.focus] even while you are @Condition[broken].

Undeniable Oblivion.name: Undeniable Oblivion
Undeniable Oblivion.description: You need not fear the destructive power of wielding the void, so powerful is your sense of self; instead, all the more effort may be focused on your unfortunate targets. Your usage of the Rune of Oblivion scales with @Rule[ability.presence] instead of @Rule[ability.intellect].

Unravel Glyph.name: Unravel Glyph
Unravel Glyph.description:
You can take a finished glyph apart stroke by stroke and see exactly how it was made. What you learn stays with you. The glyph does not.

You may spend 1 hour to unravel a glyph in your possession, destroying it. You thereafter know the schematic which produces that glyph and may craft it without holding a physical copy, as though you had already crafted it successfully.

Playtest Notes

The crafting system is in early development and schematic knowledge is not yet tracked. This talent describes how Glyphweaving will behave once it is.

Unshakeable Poise.name: Unshakeable Poise
Unshakeable Poise.description: You demonstrate exceptional poise in stressful circumstances, your cool head prevailing when others around you lose their composure.

Unshakeable Poise.name: Unshakeable Poise
Unshakeable Poise.description: You expend @Rule[resource.heroism] to instantly recover your @Rule[ability.wisdom] in @Rule[resource.focus]. You may perform this action outside of your turn in Combat before making a @Rule[action.reaction].

Unshakeable Stance.name: Unshakeable Stance
Unshakeable Stance.description:
You cannot be involuntarily moved or knocked @Condition[prone] by any action that is not a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] rolled by an enemy or a @Rule[dice.criticalFailure] rolled by yourself.

Playtest Notes

This talent is not yet automated.

Uppercut.name: Uppercut
Uppercut.description: A two-handed weapon technique where you swing your weapon upwards, making a second Strike with the backswing of your weapon.

Uppercut.name: Uppercut
Uppercut.description: Following a basic @Action[default strike] which did not @Rule[dice.criticalFailure]{Critically Miss}, you Strike the same target again with the backswing of your weapon at reduced @Rule[resource.action] cost.

Versatile Translator.name: Versatile Translator
Versatile Translator.description:
You have a scholarly background in linguistics or an intuitive knack for languages. Your capabilities enable you to decipher the basic meaning of text written in a variety of languages.

You can translate text of a language you do not know that is written using a common set of glyphs or characters to a language that you do know. Creating such a translation requires spending one minute per word to transcribe the text into a language which you understand.

Your translations are rudimentary and often lack nuance, but they do contain all essential points of the text.

Visceral Death.name: Visceral Death
Visceral Death.description: Your deliverance of death is less the introduction of decay, and more the physical wrenching of life force out of your enemies. Your usage of the Rune of Death scales with @Rule[ability.strength] instead of @Rule[ability.presence].

Voidcaller.name: Voidcaller
Voidcaller.description:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Oblivion. When you cast a Spell or use an action that involves this Rune, your @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess]{Critical Hits} which deal damage cause the @Condition[entropy] condition.

The Entropy effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half the ability score your Rune of Oblivion scales with as Void damage to @Rule[resource.health], and applies the @Condition[frightened] condition.

Volatile Accelerant.name: Volatile Accelerant
Volatile Accelerant.description: A reaction already underway needs very little encouragement. It wants fuel, or air, or a conductor, and you carry everything that is needed to make acceleration happen.

Volatile Accelerant.name: Volatile Accelerant
Volatile Accelerant.condition: You must have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped in your Toolbelt.
Volatile Accelerant.description:
You throw a measure of oil, powdered metal, or biting salts onto an enemy already suffering @Condition[burning], @Condition[freezing], @Condition[corroding], or @Condition[shocked], performing a @Rule[skill.science] skill attack against their @Rule[defense.fortitude] defense.

Upon a success they sustain damage of the same type, and to the same resource, as the reaction you fed, and its remaining duration is extended by 1 Round. Upon a @Rule[dice.criticalSuccess] the reaction also burns hotter, increasing the damage it deals each round by 1.

Playtest Notes

This action is intended to consume a unit of alchemical reagent from your inventory, offering an alternative use for the same ingredients you would otherwise craft with. That requirement is not yet implemented and awaits the design of the crafting system.

Vow of Animus.name: Vow of Animus
Vow of Animus.description: You swear a vow to destroy a specific character or creature. You gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to @Rule[action.strike]{Strike} or @Rule[action.spell]{Spell} attacks against the subject of your vow. You may only swear such a vow against one enemy at a time. Swearing a new vow relinquishes your prior vow.

Vow of Animus.name: Vow of Animus
Vow of Animus.description: You vow to vanquish a specific foe who becomes the subject of your animus.

War Mage.name: War Mage
War Mage.description: Your spellcraft is honed as a weapon of war to thwart the incantations of other magi. You may ask the Gamemaster if you know a Rune capable of countering an enemy spell, even if you do not recognize the spell being cast. You gain @Rule[dice.boon]{+2 Boons} to any @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.counterspell0000 counterspell] attempt.

Warchanter.name: Warchanter
Warchanter.description:
You are a battle-singer who turns the clamor of war into power, your chants carried on the rhythm of your own blows. You know six Chants; three Songs that strengthen your allies and three Dirges that sap your foes. You may weave multiple Chants together to craft an evolving chorus of battle, but you require the continued strikes of your weapon to fuel their song.

Beginning a chant creates an aura around you that affects other creatures on their respective turns and lasts for 1 Round. Whenever you successfully hit with a Melee attack, your Chant that is nearest to expiring is extended by 1 Round.

Song of the Titan's Might.name: Song of the Titan's Might
Song of the Titan's Might.description: You raise a thunderous anthem to the Titan, whose strength once toppled leviathans. You and allied creatures within 15 feet gain @Rule[ability.strength]{+1 Strength} and @Rule[ability.wisdom]{+1 Wisdom}.

Song of the Hunter's Alacrity.name: Song of the Hunter's Alacrity
Song of the Hunter's Alacrity.description: You loose a soaring melody to the Hunter, swift of foot and unerring of eye. You and allied creatures within 15 feet gain @Rule[ability.dexterity]{+1 Dexterity} and @Rule[ability.intellect]{+1 Intellect}.

Song of the Mountain's Endurance.name: Song of the Mountain's Endurance
Song of the Mountain's Endurance.description: You intone a rooted hymn to the Mountain, who weathered every age unbroken. You and allied creatures within 15 feet gain @Rule[ability.toughness]{+1 Toughness} and @Rule[ability.presence]{+1 Presence}.

Dirge of the Worm's Feebleness.name: Dirge of the Worm's Feebleness
