Dirge of the Worm's Feebleness.description: You hum a mocking lament that names your enemies the crawling Worm, fit only to grovel. Enemy creatures within 15 feet suffer @Rule[dice.bane]{+1 Bane} to all of their actions.

Dirge of the Glutton's Lethargy.name: Dirge of the Glutton's Lethargy
Dirge of the Glutton's Lethargy.description: You drone a dragging requiem to the Glutton, too bloated and idle to stir. Enemy creatures within 15 feet lose @Rule[movement.freeMovement] and reduce their @Rule[movement.stride] by 2.

Dirge of the Husk's Fragility.name: Dirge of the Husk's Fragility
Dirge of the Husk's Fragility.description: You keen a brittle threnody for the Husk, hollow and ready to crumble. Enemy creatures within 15 feet suffer Vulnerability of 2 to all damage types.

Warden.name: Warden
Warden.description:
You are a keeper of the old ways, a battle-druid who calls upon ancestral spirits of nature to shelter those under your protection.

You use @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.warden0000000000 ancestralGrove] to call forth an area of natural protection originating from the spiritual projection of an Ancestral Guardian.

Playtesting

The passive Resistance aura radiated by the Ancestral Guardian is not yet fully automated, pending further Aura and Region improvements.

Ancestral Grove.name: Ancestral Grove
Ancestral Grove.description:
You call forth an @UUID[Compendium.crucible.summons.Actor.ancestralGuard00]{Ancestral Guardian} which manifests at a point you can see within 30 feet. The Guardian is an incorporeal spirit that cannot be harmed or moved. Creatures can pass through its space, but it counts as three creatures for the purposes of determining whether an enemy is @Condition[flanked].

The Guardian emanates an aura with a 20 foot radius that increases the Resistance of allies to all damage types by +2.

So long as the Guardian endures, your weapon attacks against enemies within this aura cause a transfer of life-force from your enemies to your allies. Your target suffers additional Poison damage equal to half your @Rule[ability.wisdom], which is transferred as @Rule[resource.health] restoration to yourself or an ally within the grove who currently has the lowest @Rule[resource.health].

The Guardian remains until Combat ends, or until the Warden uses this action again.

Weak Points.name: Weak Points
Weak Points.description: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is @Condition[unaware], @Condition[flanked], or @Condition[exposed] using a weapon which scales with @Rule[ability.dexterity], you gain +2 damage to any Strike.

Whipstitch.name: Whipstitch
Whipstitch.description: A tailor's eye misses nothing about a garment: the loom it came from, the hand that altered it, and the body it was cut for. A tailor's hand leaves nothing behind.

Whipstitch.name: Whipstitch
Whipstitch.condition: You have a Tailor's Toolkit equipped.
Whipstitch.description:
Cloth tells you where it was woven, who wore it, and where it will give. With a Tailor's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by @Rule[skill.tailoring] which you can clearly see within 30 feet, including one a creature is wearing, learning its Quality tier, whether it was made for its current wearer or altered from another's, and what size of garment or armor would fit them.

  • Destroy. You instantaneously sever a non-magical garment, strap, or binding in your possession so that it comes apart cleanly in your hands without a blade. Alternatively you may spend 10 minutes to sabotage a non-magical work of leather or fabric. You name the condition under which it fails; when that condition is met, the Gamemaster decides the consequences. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional @Rule[skill.awareness] check which beats your passive @Rule[skill.tailoring].

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to cloth and leather, you may make or remake any garment you are familiar with, including the dress of a specific people, household, or order whose attire you have seen firsthand, which holds until the garment is closely handled or cleaned. As you work you may sew in an object weighing a pound or less, found only by an intentional @Rule[skill.awareness] check which beats your passive @Rule[skill.tailoring]. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully make any such garment outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Wild Strike.name: Wild Strike
Wild Strike.description: You have a developed familiarity with using features of your own body as natural weapons including claws, jaws, tails, or other mechanisms of self-defense.

Wild Strike.name: Wild Strike
Wild Strike.description: Immediately after you perform a basic @Action[default strike], you perform a reduced-cost follow-up Strike against the same target using a different Natural weapon that you have access to.

Wildspeaker.name: Wildspeaker
Wildspeaker.description: You have a preternatural knack for communicating with animals. Through body language and sounds, you are capable of interpreting and communicating in the language of the wilderness.

Wildspeak.name: Wildspeak
Wildspeak.description:
If you succeed on a [[/skillCheck wilderness 14]] check, you may pose simple questions to a Beast which can perceive you. As long as the creature is not hostile it will respond accurately within the limits of its own knowledge.

  • Beasts with an @Rule[ability.intellect] score of zero are incapable of understanding you.

  • Beasts with an @Rule[ability.intellect] score of 1 can only respond with "yes" or "no" responses.

  • Beasts with an @Rule[ability.intellect] score greater than 1 can provide simple multi-word responses.

Willful Life.name: Willful Life
Willful Life.description: You know you can heal any ally's physical ailments; your self confidence drives the flow of mending magic when you attend their needs. Your use of the Rune of Life scales with @Rule[ability.presence] instead of @Rule[ability.wisdom].

Withering Bolt.name: Withering Bolt
Withering Bolt.description: You loose a bolt of baleful magic which deals no damage, but leaves your foe beset by ill fortune.

Withering Bolt.name: Withering Bolt
Withering Bolt.description: You perform a @Rule[action.harmless] Talisman attack. On a success the target becomes @Condition[hexed] until the end of its next turn.

Wizard.name: Wizard
Wizard.description: You are a consummate scholar of the arcane who can sustain fluidity and momentum in your spellcraft. Once per Turn when you cast a Spell, you can carry forward a portion of its magic to reduce the @Rule[resource.focus] cost of an immediately subsequent Spell by 1.

Wortcunning.name: Wortcunning
Wortcunning.description: You know what things are made of. Years at the still and the mortar have taught you to draw an essence out of a root, and to read what another hand has put into a flask.

Wortcunning.name: Wortcunning
Wortcunning.condition: You have an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped.
Wortcunning.description:
Every preparation leaves its signature. With an Alchemist's Toolkit equipped, you can produce any one of the following effects:

  • Read. You study an item created by alchemy which you can handle, learning its Quality tier, what it will do, and whether it has degraded past use. From residue alone, a stain, a shattered flask, a scorch on stone, you identify what was prepared there if you know its recipe.

  • Destroy. You spend 10 minutes to spoil a non-magical item created by alchemy which you can physically touch, leaving a potion inert and a bomb a dud. Alternatively, in the course of preparing such a work yourself, you may leave it appearing sound while ensuring it does nothing at all when next relied upon. Your sabotage is discovered only by an intentional @Rule[skill.awareness] check which beats your passive @Rule[skill.alchemy].

  • Create. Given time and reasonable access to ingredients, you may prepare any minor alchemical work you are familiar with: inks and dyes, a glue that holds under water, a perfume that lingers a full day, fireworks in three colors, acid enough to etch a name in steel. Explicitly defined crafting recipes must still be rolled, but you can successfully prepare any such work outside of this system without requiring a dice roll.

You may attempt other uses similar to those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

Wrestler.name: Wrestler
Wrestler.description: Through leverage and technique you seize and hold creatures far larger than yourself. The @Rule[movement.size] of creature you can @Action[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.grapple000000000 grapple], and be Grappled by, increases by 1.

Zealous Smite.name: Zealous Smite
Zealous Smite.description: You can imbue righteous power into your blow with a @Rule[ability.strength]-based weapon.

Zealous Smite.name: Zealous Smite
Zealous Smite.condition: You are attacking an enemy with a Strength-based weapon.
Zealous Smite.description: You Strike using a @Rule[ability.strength]-based weapon. The attack becomes @Rule[action.deadly] and any damage dealt is Radiant.
